column2: Oil painting of a two-story yellow farmhouse with a wraparound porch, a white picket fence, and two figures at the front steps.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting of a two-story pale yellow house with a green hipped roof, a red brick chimney, and dark green shutters. A deep porch draped with vines wraps the front, raised on white lattice, with a wide stair leading down to a white picket fence. A woman in a long red dress and hat stands with a small child in white at the gate. A smaller white outbuilding sits to the right, autumn trees in orange and yellow frame the scene, and a dirt road crosses the foreground under a blue sky with large white clouds. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Oil painting of a two-story red brick house with green shutters behind a weathered wooden picket fence.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting of a symmetrical two-story red brick house with a grey roof, a chimney at each end, green shutters, and a small white-columned entry where a figure stands in the doorway. A weathered wooden picket fence runs across the middle ground and a second fence with an open gate fills the foreground, with a dirt path leading toward the house. Bare trees, pale yellow hills, and small outbuildings sit behind under a pale blue-grey sky. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Oil painting of a colorful rooster and two hens beside a water dish in a barnyard.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting of three chickens on sandy ground in front of a dark barn doorway. At right a rooster stands in profile with a red comb, orange and gold neck feathers, and a teal and blue tail. At left a buff-colored hen bends to drink from a shallow blue dish, and a white hen stands between them. Sparse weeds and small flowers dot the foreground. Signed "G Link 82" at bottom center.

column2: Oil portrait of an older woman with white hair wearing a blue dress, a pearl necklace, and a floral brooch.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting showing the head and shoulders of an older woman turned slightly to the left, with short wavy white hair, blue eyes, and a gentle smile. She wears a light blue dress with a wide collar, a pearl necklace, a pearl earring, and a yellow and white floral brooch at the collar, with a row of small buttons below. The background is loosely brushed in grey shading to warm reddish brown at right. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Oil painting of a rooster, two hens, and chicks in a barnyard beside a small wooden coop and pink flowers.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting of a barnyard scene. A rooster with a red comb, golden neck, and dark striped tail stands at center. Behind him, in front of a brown barn door, are a white hen and a brown hen with two pale chicks; a black chick and a yellow chick walk in the foreground. At left is a small weathered wooden coop with an arched opening, a feed dish in front, and a mass of pink hollyhock-like flowers behind it. The ground is sandy with patches of grass and stones. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Oil portrait of a small, shaggy cream-colored dog with its tongue out, wearing a blue ribbon.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting of a small dog with long, curly cream and tan fur, shown from the chest up and facing the viewer. The dog has dark eyes, a black nose, and a pink tongue hanging out, and wears a blue ribbon tied in a bow at its neck. The background is dark brown and grey. A faint signature, "G Link", is at lower left.

column2: Watercolor of large pink and red leaves with green edges and dark blue veins against a dark blue-grey background.
column3: A portrait-format watercolor of several large begonia-like leaves. The leaves are rosy pink to deep red in the center with yellow-green scalloped margins and dark blue veins radiating from the stem. One large leaf fills the lower center, another sits at upper left, and paler green leaves recede at the top. The background is a loose dark blue-grey wash with a blush of pink in the upper left corner. Signed "G Link 88" in blue at lower right.

column2: Marker drawing of an open-sided wooden beach shelter on sand dunes with people seated beneath it.
column3: A portrait-format black marker drawing on cream paper of a flat-roofed, open-sided wooden pavilion raised on posts above sand dunes. Several people sit or lean in deck chairs under the roof, drawn as dark silhouettes. Steps descend at left, the deck casts a cross-hatched shadow on the sand, and clumps of dune grass grow at both sides. Loose lines suggest footprints in the foreground sand. Signed "G Link Ju 77" at lower right, with "Nagshead" written in pencil below.

column2: Oil still life of a woven basket filled with leafy greens and corn, with two yellow squash and a tomato in front of a brick wall.
column3: A nearly square oil painting of a brown woven basket with a tall arched handle, holding leafy green vegetables and an ear of corn in its husk. Two yellow crookneck squash and a red tomato rest on the brown table in front of it. The background is golden yellow at left and a red brick wall at right. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Oil painting of a Raggedy Ann doll and a dark teddy bear seated together in a small wooden rocking chair.
column3: A square, thickly painted oil of two toys sharing a cream-colored child's rocking chair with a woven seat. At left is a dark brown teddy bear with a tan muzzle and a red plaid scarf; at right is a Raggedy Ann doll with red yarn hair, a white face with a triangular red nose, a blue dress, and red-and-white striped arms and legs. The background is bold orange-red with green passages, and the floor is patterned in blue, red, and yellow.

column2: Oil portrait of a smiling teenage boy with dark hair wearing a teal collared shirt.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting showing the head and shoulders of a teenage boy facing the viewer, with thick dark wavy hair, dark eyes, heavy eyebrows, and a closed-mouth smile. He wears a teal polo shirt with an open collar and one white button. The background is a soft blue-grey. Signed "G Link" in blue at lower left.

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a two-story brick house with shutters and a one-story wing, surrounded by trees and shrubs.
column3: A landscape-format ink drawing lightly tinted with colored pencil on cream paper. It shows a two-story house in pale red brick with a grey gabled roof, dark red shutters, and a pedimented front door at left atop semicircular steps, with a one-story wing and covered porch extending to the right. Chimneys rise at both ends, outlined trees shaded in green stand behind, and rounded shrubs and a small tree line the foundation and curved driveway. Inscribed "May 80 G Link" in pencil at lower right.

column2: Painting of a seated woman in a hat weaving a sweetgrass basket, surrounded by finished baskets, some hanging on a wooden rack.
column3: A portrait-format painting on cream paper of a Black woman seated in a wooden chair, wearing a brown brimmed hat, red jacket, white blouse and apron, and blue skirt, looking down at a basket she holds in her lap. Golden coiled sweetgrass baskets of many shapes sit around her feet, some holding bundles of grass, and a loose bundle of grass lies on the ground. At right a rough wooden rack displays five more handled baskets. Much of the paper is left bare. Signed "G Link" at lower left and inscribed "Charlston '83" at lower right.

column2: Watercolor of a large salmon-pink amaryllis bloom with green strap-like leaves.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor of a single open amaryllis flower in salmon pink and coral, with a pale yellow-green throat and yellow-tipped stamens. Long green leaves fan out behind and below it, a green bud sits at the top, and a second, fainter bloom appears at right. The background is a soft wash of pale yellow, green, and blue fading to bare paper. Signed "G Link" below the flower.

column2: Pastel still life of a blue bowl of fruit, a green apple, a tall blue-green vase, and a dark pitcher on a striped cloth.
column3: A landscape-format pastel still life. At left a deep blue bowl holds a red apple, a green apple, and yellow fruit; a second green apple sits on the table beside it. At right stand a tall, tapering blue-green ceramic vase and a dark brown pitcher with a pale rim. The objects rest on a rumpled white cloth with thin red stripes, and the background is hatched in ochre, rust, and blue. Signed "G Link 90" at lower left.

column2: Watercolor of an ochre adobe-style church with a rust-red roof and a belfry topped by a cross, with chickens in the yard.
column3: A portrait-format watercolor of the gable end of an orange-ochre stuccoed building with a rust-red roof, a small-paned window, and a wooden door. A square belfry with a pointed roof and a wooden cross rises above the ridge. A bare, forked tree trunk stands against the wall beside a stone wall and an open doorway at left, and a weathered post and dark shed stand at right. Several dark chickens peck in the shaded dirt yard. Green trees and a bright blue sky with white clouds fill the background. Signed "G Link" at lower right.

column2: Watercolor of whitewashed village houses with tiled roofs, laundry on a line, three figures in a doorway, and chickens in the yard.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor of three pale grey and white houses with tan clay-tile roofs around a sandy yard under a blue sky. Laundry in reds and oranges hangs on a line along a wall at left. A woman, a small child, and a figure in dark clothing stand near an arched passage at center. In the foreground a grey hen, a red rooster, and another bird at a feed dish stand on the ochre ground. Signed "G Link" at left.

column2: Watercolor of a brick house with a tall chimney and snow-covered roof, surrounded by bare trees and deep snow.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor of a two-and-a-half-story red brick house with a steep snow-covered roof, a tall brick chimney, and a snow-capped arched entry. A second brick gable with dark shutters stands at left, with a snow-covered car parked in front. Bare trees dusted with snow stand in the yard, an evergreen is at right, and distant houses appear on a hill under a grey winter sky. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Watercolor of a red barn and farm buildings on a rise above a pond, with bare trees and autumn grasses.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor of a farm in late autumn. A red barn with a grey roof and white lean-to stands at center on a grassy rise, with a smaller red outbuilding, a white farmhouse, a fence, and tall bare trees to the left. Golden hills roll away at right. A still pond fills the foreground, reflecting the barn and sky, edged with rust-colored brush and dried wildflowers. The sky is blue with billowing white clouds. Signed at lower right.

column2: Watercolor of people at a red food cart with yellow wheels in a park, with pigeons in the foreground and a domed building in the distance.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor of a red vendor's wagon with yellow spoked wheels, gold trim, and a striped canopy, parked on a broad path. A vendor is visible inside, and two customers seen from behind, one with a red backpack, stand at the counter. Other pedestrians, including an adult with a small child in a red coat, walk along the tree-lined path toward a pale domed building resembling the United States Capitol. Three pigeons peck on the ground at lower left and another perches on the cart roof. Signed "G Link" at lower right, with a faint word "Lunch" below.

column2: Watercolor of two weathered beach houses among dunes with the ocean behind them under a stormy grey sky.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor of two houses on sandy dunes. At left is a tall, pale yellow house with a red hipped roof and rooftop cupola, with wooden steps at its side; at right is a dark grey shingled cottage with a brick chimney and a deck flying a small red flag. The blue-grey ocean stretches between them beneath heavy dark clouds. Dune shrubs, grasses, and yellow and red wildflowers fill the foreground. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Watercolor of a bouquet of yellow, red, purple, and pink primroses in a metal Irish oatmeal tin.
column3: A portrait-format watercolor centered on white paper, showing a dense bunch of primrose-like flowers in yellow, red, purple, pink, and orange above broad green leaves. The flowers stand in a cylindrical grey metal tin lettered "IRISH OATM..." that rests on a round tan surface. A loose blue and violet wash surrounds the bouquet. Signed "G Link" at lower left of the painted area.

column2: Pastel still life of a red geranium in a blue pot with a red apple, a green pear, and an orange on a blue cloth.
column3: A portrait-format pastel still life in bright color. A potted geranium with two clusters of pink-red blossoms and scalloped green leaves stands in a blue pot at right. In front of it are a dark red apple, a yellow-green pear, and a large orange, arranged on a pale blue surface. The background is vivid yellow with touches of orange and lavender. Signed "G Link 90" at lower left.

column2: Pastel still life of purple grapes, a red apple, a pear, and an orange beside a brown and cream stoneware jug.
column3: A landscape-format pastel still life. At left a bunch of purple grapes with a green leaf and curling tendrils sits on a dish behind a red apple, a yellow-green pear, and an orange. At right is a rounded stoneware jug with a brown glazed top, a lid, a handle, and a cream lower half. The objects sit on a white cloth over a wooden table, with a blue drape behind the jug and a pale yellow background. Signed "G Link 90" at lower right.

column2: Pastel still life of two stoneware jugs, a green bell pepper, a yellow squash, and a bowl of apple, orange, and red grapes.
column3: A landscape-format pastel still life. Two brown stoneware vessels stand at the back, one a wide-mouthed pitcher with a handle and the other a taller crock with a white lower half. In front lie a green bell pepper and a yellow crookneck squash, and at right a brown bowl holds a red apple, an orange, and a bunch of red grapes spilling over the rim. The setting is a white cloth with blue shadows against a pale yellow and peach background. Signed "G Link 90" at lower right.

column2: Oil painting of a small stone church with steep grey roofs, an arched entry porch, and a belfry, set among dark trees.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting in muted greys and ochres of a stone church seen from a front corner. It has steep grey roofs, a gabled porch with a large round-arched opening at right, a smaller side porch at left, and a small louvered belfry rising above the ridge. Ivy climbs the wall beside the porch. Dark grey-green trees stand behind, and the foreground is loosely brushed ground in ochre and grey. No signature is visible.

column2: Oil portrait study in brown and grey tones of a person with short hair looking to the left.
column3: A portrait-format oil study painted almost entirely in browns, tans, and greys. It shows the head and shoulders of a person with short, tousled brown hair, turned in three-quarter view and gazing to the left with a serious expression. They wear a dark crew-neck top. The background is a loosely brushed warm tan with a dark shadow at left. Signed "G Link" in white at lower left.

column2: Pastel of a white columned cupola with a green roof and finial, overlooking a hillside town and distant blue mountains.
column3: A landscape-format pastel on tan paper. In the foreground at right of center stands an open, arched and columned white cupola with a grey-green bell-shaped roof topped by an ornamental finial, rising from a stone base above dark rooftops. Behind it a green valley dotted with small white and red-roofed houses stretches to low blue mountains, with a water tower on the horizon at left and full green trees at right. The sky is streaked blue and white. Signed and dated "'78" at lower right.

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a two-story brick house with a columned front porch, shaded by a large tree.
column3: A landscape-format ink drawing tinted with colored pencil on cream paper. A two-story red brick house with many-paned windows, a green-grey roof, and a brick chimney is seen at an angle, with a hip-roofed front porch on square posts sheltering a paneled double door. A large tree trunk fills the left edge and its leafy branches reach across the roof. A fence and outbuilding are visible behind at left, and daylilies grow along the foundation at right. Signed "G Link May '82" at lower right.

column2: Brown ink drawing of a small white church with a steeple in a mountain valley, with a barn and rail fences in the foreground.
column3: A portrait-format drawing in brown ink on cream paper. A clapboard church with a square belfry and tall slender spire stands at right center, facing a lane lined with a board fence. At left the tall gable of a weathered barn and a small shed rise beside a leaning utility pole whose wires cross the scene. A split-rail fence and a small roofed trough occupy the foreground, and outlined mountain ridges with a few birds fill the sky. Signed "G Link May '82" at lower right.

column2: Brown ink drawing of a large stone fireplace with a wooden mantel displaying plates and pitchers, flanked by bookshelves and an armchair.
column3: A landscape-format drawing in brown ink on tan paper of a room interior. A wide stone fireplace with a shallow arched opening holds andirons, logs, and a kettle hanging from an iron crane. The heavy wooden mantel carries a large round charger, plates, pitchers, a covered dish, and a candlestick, with a bundle of dried corn hanging at left and a lantern and utensils at right. Bookshelves stand on either side, a wingback armchair with a plaid pillow is at left, a wood box sits on the stone hearth, and a child's rocking chair is at lower right. Signed "G Link Feb '80" at lower left.

column2: Abstract oil painting of a city skyline made of tall, vertical brushstrokes in grey, cream, and blue.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting of a cluster of skyscrapers rendered as soft, blurred vertical strokes. Pale cream and white towers rise at center against a hazy blue-grey sky, surrounded by darker grey, blue, and brown forms, with small accents of red and ochre near the bottom. Short horizontal dashes suggest windows. Signed "G Link" in white at lower right.

column2: Pastel still life of a poinsettia in a green pot with an orange and a green apple against a dark blue background.
column3: A portrait-format pastel still life. A potted poinsettia with bright green serrated leaves and several red bracts fills the upper two-thirds, set in a green pot. An orange and a green apple sit in front on a white surface. The background is deep blue and violet, lightening to bright blue at the edges. Signed "G Link '90" at lower left.

column2: Oil still life of orange, yellow, and white chrysanthemums in a white footed bowl with green grapes beside it.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting of a bouquet of large chrysanthemum-like blooms in orange, golden yellow, and white, with sprays of rust-colored foliage, arranged in a white footed bowl set on a plate. A bunch of green grapes lies at the lower left of the bowl. The background and tabletop are soft olive green and ochre. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Pastel of a small brick building with a steep pyramid-shaped roof, seen through trees and shrubs.
column3: A nearly square pastel on cream paper. A low red brick building with a steep, dark slate pyramidal roof and a small white gabled doorway sits at center, partly hidden by rounded green shrubs. Dark tree branches arch across the top from the left and a tall evergreen trunk rises at right beside a white fence. The lawn in front is bright green with blue shadows and clumps of leafy plants.

column2: Watercolor view through a four-pane window of a log cabin, outhouse, rail fence, and mountains, with bottles on the sill.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor framed by the brown mullions of a window. Outside, a weathered log cabin with a shingle roof and a window box of red flowers stands at left beside a small grey outhouse. A split-rail fence crosses a green yard, and beyond it a yellow field rises to a small white building, green wooded hills, and blue mountains. On the windowsill, blue and amber glass bottles stand at lower left and a blue jug and small bottle at lower right.

column2: Loose watercolor of a house corner and window with a twisting vine and orange autumn foliage above green shrubs.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor sketch within a ruled pencil border on cream paper. It shows the corner of a building with a dark grey-violet roof and a deep blue window, crossed by twisting brown vine stems carrying orange and yellow autumn leaves. Dark and light green shrubs anchor the base and a small tree with orange leaves stands at right. A paper label at lower right reads "lgpst000037".

column2: Watercolor of a grey wooden garden gate with a lamp post, a small tree, and colorful flowers along a brick path.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor within a ruled pencil border on cream paper. A weathered grey board gate with a scalloped top stands at center in a rail fence, with a tall grey lamp post and lantern beside it. A red brick path leads to the gate. A small leafy tree grows at left, and at right flowers bloom in red, orange, yellow, and blue, including a tall blue delphinium-like spike. The background is a pale green wash. A paper label at lower right reads "lgpst000038".

column2: Watercolor of a weathered grey barn with a tan roof, a rail fence, tall trees, and a small figure standing by the door.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor vignette on cream paper. A grey board barn with a tan shingled roof and an attached taller section stands at center behind a wooden rail fence. A small dark figure stands near the building beside a tall, slender tree. Soft washes of green, blue-grey, and gold suggest surrounding trees, including a yellow-orange autumn tree at right, and orange flowers bloom in the foreground. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Brown marker drawing of a tall cylindrical water tower rising above tiled rooftops and trees in a hillside town.
column3: A portrait-format drawing in brown marker with pale blue and pink colored pencil shading on cream paper. A tall, tapering cylindrical tower with a wide tank at the top and a ladder up its side dominates the upper left. Below and around it are tile-roofed buildings, chimneys, and trees, with more houses climbing a hill at right. Inscribed at lower right: "G Link, Hotel Abalia, Albufeara '79, Portugal".

column2: Watercolor of a curving garden path between beds of blue, red, and yellow flowers leading to a white birdbath and trees.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor of a grey path winding from the foreground between dense flower borders in blue, red, yellow, pink, and orange, with tall blue delphinium-like spikes at both sides. The path leads to a white pedestal birdbath in front of a group of round, dark green trees. Beyond lie a pale open field, two small trees, and a blue-green treeline and hills under a blue-grey sky. A white gate post is at far left. Signed "G Link" in blue at lower left.

column2: Watercolor portrait of a smiling woman with short dark hair wearing large sunglasses, a white turtleneck, and a red sweater.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor on cream paper showing the head and shoulders of a woman facing the viewer and smiling. She has short dark grey-black hair, large dark sunglasses, and small earrings, and wears a white turtleneck under a red sweater with a beaded necklace. The background is a loose wash of blue-grey and tan that fades to bare paper. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Watercolor of a white lighthouse and keeper's house on a harbor with a sailboat, a small fishing boat, and a figure on the shore.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor of a harbor scene. A tall, tapering white lighthouse with a dark lantern room stands at left behind a white two-story keeper's house with a grey roof, dormers, and porch. Wooden pilings and a stone breakwater line the shore. On the blue water at right a white sailboat with a tall mast and furled sail is anchored near a small motorboat, with more white houses and green trees behind. A small figure in a red shirt and hat fishes from the rocky sandy shore at lower left. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Watercolor of a large pale building with a rooftop cupola and columned porch, framed by trees in yellow and orange autumn color.
column3: A portrait-format watercolor of a large cream-colored building with a square windowed cupola on its roof and a one-story columned porch painted in blue-grey. Two small dark figures stand on the walk in front of the porch. Tall trees with golden yellow, orange, and rust foliage frame the building on both sides, green shrubs line the foundation, and the foreground is washed in yellow and blue-grey with a lightly sketched stone wall at the bottom. The sky is pale blue.

column2: Watercolor of an old, weathered wooden boat beached beside a rickety pier, with hazy hills across the water.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor in muted browns and greys. A derelict wooden fishing boat with a small wheelhouse, broken windows, and two bare masts rests at the edge of calm water, its hull stained and patched. A dilapidated wooden pier with railings stands behind it, and its pilings reflect in the still water. Pale hills line the far shore beneath a hazy cream sky, and a brown mudflat fills the foreground. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Oil painting of a white garden arbor covered in pink roses over stone steps and a path, with flower borders and a white fence.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting on unstretched canvas, with the lower third left unpainted. A white wooden arbor draped with pink climbing roses spans a set of stone steps that lead to a curving path and a white rail fence beyond. Flower beds in pink, purple, yellow, and white line both sides, with a white picket fence at right. Dense dark green trees and a patch of blue sky fill the background, and green lawn is brushed in loosely below.

column2: Oil painting of a woman in a long white dress and a small child walking toward round white farm buildings with red roofs.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting. At right, seen from behind, a woman in a long white dress and flowered hat walks hand in hand with a small child in a white dress and straw hat along a dirt path. They approach a group of buildings: a large round white structure with a rust-red roof, a smaller open pavilion with a pointed red conical roof on posts, and at right a long building with a blue-green metal roof and arched porch. Clipped hedges border the yard, trees stand among the buildings, and blue mountains rise under a cloudy sky. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Oil painting of weathered farm buildings with red roofs on a hilltop under a cloudy sky, with a bare tree in the foreground.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting of a hillside farm in muted winter color. On the crest stand a grey barn with a red roof and red lower doors, a tall narrow board shed, and a small white house with a red roof, with a utility pole at right. A bare, pale-barked tree with a few rust leaves rises at left, and brush and fence posts dot the brown and ochre slope. The sky is streaked grey and white with patches of blue.

column2: Oil still life of purple, yellow, white, and maroon pansies in a glass bowl on a wooden table, with two cut pansies beside it.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting of a low, rounded glass bowl filled with pansies in yellow, white, deep purple, and maroon, each with dark face markings. Two more pansies with green stems lie on the brown wooden tabletop at lower left. The background shades from near black at left to pale grey-green at right. Signed "Gretchen Link" at lower right.

column2: Oil still life of a copper coffee pot with cauliflower, tomatoes, mushrooms, carrots, and an onion on a white cloth.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting on unstretched canvas with tack holes along the edges. A tall copper coffee pot with a hinged lid and handle stands at left. Around it are an eggplant and an onion at left, a white head of cauliflower in green leaves at center, two red tomatoes, three brown mushrooms, a bunch of carrots, and a green vegetable at right. The objects rest on a white cloth against a dark brown background. A faint signature is at lower left.

column2: Pastel on brown paper showing, from behind, a man seated in a woven lawn chair holding a small child in a white cap.
column3: A portrait-format pastel on brown paper. Seen from behind, a man with dark hair wearing a red shirt and light blue trousers sits in an aluminum lawn chair with green webbing. A small child in a white cap rests against his left shoulder. Loose strokes of green, yellow, and white suggest a birch tree at left, dense foliage ahead of them, and grass underfoot. Signed "G Link 78" at lower left.

column2: Pastel of two butterflies, an orange one with black-and-white spotted edges above and a yellow swallowtail on blossoms below.
column3: A tall, narrow pastel on grey-brown paper. At the top an orange butterfly with black wing borders dotted with white is shown in profile with wings closed. At the bottom a yellow swallowtail with black stripes and blue and red spots near its tail feeds on a cluster of pale pink blossoms. The background is blended green and blue. Signed "G Link 77" at lower left.

column2: Small oil painting of a red-and-white striped lighthouse beside a white house at a harbor with docks and a distant sailboat.
column3: A landscape-format oil scene painted as a small rectangle in the center of a larger piece of unprimed canvas. A lighthouse with red and white horizontal bands and a dark lantern room stands beside a white building with a dark roof. A curving walkway with pilings and tan docks lead out over blue water at left, where a small sailboat appears on the horizon. A flagpole with a red flag, green lawn, and trees are at right, under a pale blue sky.

column2: Watercolor of a beach with a red umbrella and chairs on a dune, sea oats, people fishing at the water's edge, and gulls overhead.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor of a beach seen from the dunes. A scalloped red beach umbrella shades a blue-and-white striped lounge chair and a green chair beside a tall clump of sea oats. At left are weathered wooden posts and a vine. Small figures stand along the shore, one casting a fishing rod, and a second red umbrella sits farther down the beach at right. The ocean is a calm blue-grey band under a pale sky with three gulls. Signed "G Link" in orange at left, with "'94" at lower left and "Nags Head" at lower right in pencil.

column2: Pen and watercolor botanical study of a tiger lily stem with three orange spotted blooms and several buds.
column3: A tall, narrow pen and watercolor drawing on cream paper of a single tiger lily stem running the height of the sheet. Three open flowers have strongly recurved orange petals with dark spots and long stamens tipped with dark anthers; several closed orange buds hang near the top, and narrow green leaves line the stem. A pale yellow wash sits behind the center. Signed "Link 1978" at lower right.

column2: Watercolor of a round red brick tower with arched windows and a conical grey shingled roof against a blue sky.
column3: A portrait-format watercolor looking up at a round red brick turret. It has a band of three arched windows, a small plaque above them, a projecting bracketed cornice, a narrower upper stage ringed with small windows, and a steep conical roof of grey scalloped shingles ending in a pointed finial. A faint wash suggests the adjoining roofline, and the sky is washed in soft blue with white clouds.

column2: Watercolor of a large weeping willow on a small island in a pond with a brick structure and two ducks swimming in front.
column3: A portrait-format watercolor on white paper. A weeping willow with a dark forked trunk and cascading yellow-green foliage covers a small stone-edged island. Beneath it stands a small red brick structure with a grey roof and a brick chimney-like top, and a second low brick form is at left. Blue water surrounds the island and two grey ducks swim in the foreground. Signed "G Link '86" at lower left.

column2: Watercolor of a grey ladder-back chair with a woven rush seat, with a tan cat curled on the floor beside it.
column3: A portrait-format watercolor on a sheet with spiral-binding perforations along the top. A dark grey wooden ladder-back chair with two back slats and a golden woven rush seat is seen from a low angle, casting a blue shadow on the wall behind. At lower right a rounded tan and brown shape appears to be a cat curled up asleep. The background is a loose blue wash. Signed at lower right.

column2: Watercolor view from a covered porch with white turned posts and railing, looking over dune grass to the ocean.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor on cream paper. The viewer stands on a porch with a green board floor and green ceiling, white turned posts, and a white railing that meets at a corner. Beyond the railing, golden dune grass and dark shrubs lead to a pale beach and a blue-grey ocean under a cloudy sky, with a dark headland at right. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Watercolor street scene of brightly painted red, blue, and yellow buildings with dark figures walking in the street.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor of a cluster of multi-story buildings painted in bold red, blue, yellow, orange, and green, some sided in corrugated panels, with balconies, shutters, and rooftop antennas. An ornate black street lamp stands at left and a small kiosk with a striped awning is at center left. A crowd of small, dark-clothed figures in hats walks through the grey street. Signed "G Link" at lower left, with a faint pencil inscription at lower right.

column2: Light brown pencil sketch of a harbor with moored sailboats, a ferry or large boat at a dock, sheds, and a house on a point.
column3: A landscape-format sketch in light brown pencil on cream paper, drawn in loose outline. Several small sailboats and a cabin boat float in the foreground with squiggled reflections. Beyond them a long, low vessel with a tall mast lies at a dock near two shed-like buildings, and a large house sits on a spit of land at upper left with open water behind. An evergreen is sketched at lower left and a rowboat at lower right. Inscribed "Woods hole" in pencil near the bottom.

column2: Watercolor of an abandoned, weathered wooden farmhouse with a rusted metal roof and sagging porch on a grassy hillside.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor on cream paper. A grey, unpainted board house with a patchwork rust-red and brown metal roof stands on a slope, with a small gabled addition at left and a sagging porch on thin posts at right. A row of fence posts runs up the tan hill behind, and tufts of green grass grow in the ochre foreground. The sky is soft blue-grey. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Watercolor of a clump of bearded irises in peach, pink, lavender, and purple with long green leaves.
column3: A portrait-format watercolor on cream paper of a tall stand of bearded irises. Blooms in peach-orange, rose pink, lavender, and deep purple open at varying heights among upright blue-green and yellow-green sword-shaped leaves, with several tight buds on tall stems. A soft yellow wash glows behind the upper flowers and a blue-grey wash shades the right side. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Oil still life of purple tulips, mauve roses, and pale pink stock in a white vase with painted flowers, against a green wall.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting of a bouquet in a fluted white ceramic vase decorated with a small floral spray and gold trim. The arrangement includes dark purple tulips, mauve rose-like blooms, peach flowers, white clustered blossoms, and tall spikes of pale pink stock. The vase stands on a dark brown polished table that reflects it, against a pale green wall on which the bouquet casts a soft shadow. Signed "Gretchen Link '45" at lower left.

column2: Oil still life of a worn brown shoe, a yellow vase holding long leaves, and a dark blue bottle on green drapery.
column3: A landscape-format painting in thin, washy color. A battered brown ankle boot lies on its side at left. Behind it a yellow jug-like vase holds a spray of long, drooping olive-brown leaves around a dark red seed cluster. A dark blue bottle lies on its side at lower right. The objects rest on rumpled yellow-green cloth over a brown surface, against a pale blue-grey and ochre background.

column2: Oil painting of a small, abandoned red wooden railway station with a hipped roof, overgrown with weeds and shrubs.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting of a one-story red board-and-batten building with a wide, overhanging hipped roof in weathered grey and tan, ornamental ridge ends, and a red brick chimney. A projecting bay window, doors, and boarded openings face a low platform. Weeds, shrubs, and tall grasses grow up around it, a utility pole stands at left, and dark green trees and blue mountains lie behind under a cloudy blue sky. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Watercolor of a woman in a straw hat and long blue button-front dress standing on a sandy path beside a dune fence.
column3: A portrait-format watercolor on deckle-edged paper. A woman stands facing the viewer on a sand path, smiling, wearing a yellow straw hat and an ankle-length, short-sleeved blue dress buttoned down the front. A weathered wooden slat sand fence curves along the dune behind her and casts striped shadows across the sand at right. Dune grass grows on the rise at upper right, and a strip of blue ocean is visible at left under a grey-blue sky. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Pastel still life of blue-black grapes and yellow-green grapes with vine leaves beside a copper-colored pot.
column3: A landscape-format pastel on paper with torn and stained edges. A bunch of dark blue grapes lies in the foreground in front of a rounded copper-brown vessel with an uneven rim. A bunch of golden-yellow grapes with green vine leaves and a curling tendril sits at left, another leaf lies at right, and a few loose grapes rest on the dark tabletop. The background is soft grey. Signed "Gretchen Link" at lower left.

column2: Watercolor of woven baskets and a pot of dried flowers on top of a dark cabinet draped with a red-and-white woven coverlet.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor on cream paper. On top of a dark blue-grey cabinet sit a dark pot of dried rust and pink flowers, a small tan handled basket, a large rectangular lidded wicker hamper, and a grey splint basket with a tall arched handle perched on top. A red-and-white patterned woven coverlet with fringe hangs over the right side of the cabinet, which has an open shelf holding books. The background is a soft grey wash. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Oil still life of a pewter pitcher holding dark magnolia leaves beside a bowl of fruit on a dark table against a yellow wall.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting. A dark pewter pitcher with a curved handle and spout holds branches of glossy dark green magnolia leaves. In front at right, a footed bowl holds a banana, green and red apples, an orange, a pear, and purple grapes, and a pomegranate and a walnut rest on a blue-and-white checked cloth. A blue cloth hangs over a chair post at lower left. The table is nearly black and the wall behind is mottled golden yellow. Signed "G. Link 82" at lower right.

column2: Oil painting of a farm pond reflecting a red-roofed white barn, with a leaning tree in the foreground and golden hills behind.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting. A still pond in the foreground mirrors a small white barn with a red roof standing on the far bank. A second white barn with a pale roof stands at right beside a large, dark green tree. At left a slender, forked tree with sparse yellow-green leaves leans across the scene. Rolling golden-tan hills and darker wooded ridges rise behind under a pale blue, lightly clouded sky. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Oil portrait of a young girl with long strawberry-blonde hair and a yellow bow, in a white blouse and full blue skirt, holding flowers.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting of a girl shown three-quarter length, her body turned to the right as she looks back over her shoulder toward the viewer. Her long reddish-blonde hair falls down her back and is tied at the crown with a yellow-green ribbon. She wears a white blouse with puffed sleeves and a full, shimmering blue skirt, and holds a small bouquet of pink flowers. The background is very dark, with the suggestion of a deep red curtain at left. Signed "G Link" in red at lower right.

column2: Pastel portrait of a young girl with blonde braided hair tied with pink ribbons, wearing a pink dress with a white collar.
column3: A portrait-format pastel on tan paper with worn, stained edges. A small girl faces the viewer with a calm expression; her blonde hair is parted in the center and drawn into two looped braids tied with pink bows. She wears a pink dress with a white rounded collar, small buttons, and white lace trim forming a V. The background is rubbed blue-green and brown. Signed twice at lower right, "G. Link '44".

column2: Watercolor of three older women chatting outside a grey shingled cottage, one leaning on a broom and one seated in a rocking chair.
column3: A portrait-format watercolor on cream paper. At left a white-haired woman with glasses, seen from behind in a blue polka-dot dress, leans on a straw broom. Facing her on a stone step are a white-haired woman in a pink dress standing with hands on hips and smiling, and a woman in a blue dress and white apron seated in a wooden rocking chair with sewing in her lap. Behind them is a steep-gabled, grey shingled cottage with a small sign above its wooden door and a second cottage at left. Pink rambling roses, green vines, and yellow flowers surround the doorway. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Pastel on blue paper of a woman with dark bobbed hair in an embroidered blue-green robe, seated in profile beside a vase of daisies.
column3: A portrait-format pastel on deep blue paper mounted on a cream backing. A woman with chin-length dark hair and bangs sits in a wooden chair, turned in profile to the left with a slight smile. She wears a loose blue-green robe embroidered with yellow, red, and gold motifs, and rests her hand near a tall glass vase of white and yellow daisy-like flowers on a table. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Watercolor of a snow-covered hillside neighborhood of brick houses, with a low brick house and an orange car in the foreground.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor of a residential hillside in snow. In the foreground a one-story brick ranch house with a snow-laden roof has a snow shovel propped by its door and a small orange hatchback car parked in front; the tall gable of a brick house and a snow-dusted evergreen stand at left. Beyond, dozens of red brick and yellow houses with white roofs climb the hill among bare trees and evergreens under a pale grey-blue sky. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Watercolor of a weathered grey wooden house with a rusted roof and brick chimney, in tall golden grass behind a broken gate.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor on tan paper. A small abandoned house of grey boards with a rust-streaked metal roof, a brick chimney, and a low front porch stands in a field of tall yellow grass. A sagging wooden gate and wire fence posts cross the foreground, a bare twisted tree stands at right, and blue-grey hills and a heavy cloudy sky fill the distance. Signed and dated at lower right.

column2: Oil still life of a dented metal pail on its side, two red apples, a piece of driftwood, and a green glass bottle.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting. A battered grey metal bucket with a wire handle lies tipped on its side at left, with two red apples and a gnarled grey piece of driftwood in front of it. A clear green glass bottle with a long neck stands at right. The tabletop is pale yellow and the background is loosely brushed brown and ochre. Signed "G Link 78" at lower left.

column2: Abstract painting of loose smears and swirls of dark red, blue, and yellow paint with thin green lines on a white ground.
column3: A landscape-format abstract work on white paper. Broad, smeared strokes of dark red and maroon dominate the left and center, mixed with patches of mustard yellow, purple, and blue, and a blue and purple smear stands apart at right. Thin wandering lines in green, magenta, and yellow are drawn over and around the paint. The marks are free and gestural, resembling finger painting, with large areas of the white ground left bare.

column2: Oil painting of a pale stone church tower with an arched doorway and round window against a deep blue night sky.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting on canvas board. A tall, square church tower with a crenellated top, a round rose window, and a pointed-arch doorway glows in pale pink and white against a deep blue evening sky. Steps lead up to the door, the body of the church recedes in shadow on both sides, and dark trees with touches of orange autumn leaves frame the tower. The lower edge is loosely brushed and partly unfinished.

column2: Oil painting of a hillside cemetery with a tall stone monument and headstones, overlooking rolling fields and blue mountains.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting. A tall, ornate grey monument with a columned shaft and urn stands at right center among upright headstones and obelisks, with a rounded gravestone in the foreground at left. A slender tree rises along the left edge. Beyond the cemetery, green shrubs give way to rolling yellow-green hills with a small white house, and blue mountains under a pale blue sky with soft clouds.

column2: Oil painting of a seated woman in profile wearing a blue headscarf, white blouse, and red skirt, holding a decorated ceramic jar.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting of a woman seated on a bentwood chair, turned in profile to the left toward a window. She has wavy brown hair under a blue patterned headscarf, a gold earring, a loose white blouse, a full tiered red skirt, gold bangles, and a red ring. She holds a rounded cream-colored pottery jar with brown decoration in her lap. The wall behind is blue-grey, and a bare branch shows through the window. Signed and dated at lower right.

column2: Oil portrait in an eighteenth-century style of an older woman in a white lace cap and dark gown, seated doing needlework.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting of an older woman seated in a red upholstered armchair with a gilt frame, looking toward the viewer. She wears a ruffled white lace cap, a white fichu and stomacher, a dark gown with lace cuffs over a full white skirt, and holds thread and a small shuttle in her hands, with a blue silk workbag trimmed in white hanging from her arm. A dark red curtain hangs at upper left against a nearly black background. Signed "G Link" at lower right.

column2: Watercolor of a weathered grey wooden chicken house with a patched roof, chickens in the yard, and a brick house behind.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor on a mounted sheet. A long, low grey board outbuilding with a tall central gable, a patched and rusted roof, and several dark door and window openings stands on a grassy rise. Two orange-brown chickens peck at lower right. Behind at right is a red brick house with chimneys, and soft brown and grey trees fill the left background under a pale blue and tan sky. Signed "G Link" at lower left, with a faint pencil caption below reading "Chicken house - Walter Link Farm".

column2: Oil painting of a dense flower garden with yellow and orange lilies, red bee balm, daisies, and a hummingbird hovering at right.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting crowded with garden flowers. Large yellow and orange daylilies with arching green leaves fill the center, surrounded by black-eyed Susans at left, red bee balm, white daisies, and yellow yarrow at right, and tall pink and lavender flower spikes behind. A hummingbird hovers above the red blooms at upper right. The background is hazy pale yellow and blue with dark green foliage at upper left. Signed at lower left.

column2: Watercolor of a young boy in a red baseball cap, white sweatshirt, and jeans, standing on a base with a ball and glove.
column3: A portrait-format watercolor in a cream mat. A small boy with dark curly hair stands facing the viewer on a worn white base, wearing a red baseball cap tilted on his head, a white long-sleeved shirt, blue jeans, and sneakers. He holds a baseball in his right hand and a brown leather glove on his left, with a serious expression. The ground is tan dirt and the background is a blue-grey wash crossed by white lines suggesting a backstop fence. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Oil painting in an antique style of a girl in a yellow dress with a basket of Easter eggs and a small boy in blue with a toy horse.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting of two young children standing on a path in a wooded landscape. At left a girl with long light-brown hair wears a yellow dress with a lace collar and blue sash over white pantalettes; she holds a small bouquet and carries a woven basket of colored eggs. At right a smaller boy with short brown hair wears a blue jacket with a lace collar and white trousers and holds the string of a wooden pull-toy horse on a green wheeled base. Dark trees frame a cloudy sky. Signed and dated "Link 82" at lower left.

column2: Printed wedding invitation set in a hand-painted border of beach scenes: umbrella, sandcastle, sailboat, picnic basket, and chairs.
column3: A portrait-format mixed-media piece. A printed invitation in grey script, announcing an evening wedding at Folly Beach, Charleston, South Carolina, fills the center inside a painted black-and-white checkered frame with gold scrollwork. The surrounding border is painted as a sandy beach: at top, ocean with a red rowboat, a sailboat, and two kites; at left, a red umbrella, striped towel with an open book, sand pail, radio, and blue sandals; at bottom, a sandcastle, beach ball, books, starfish, and straw hat; at right, a white Adirondack chair with an American flag, seashells, and a picnic basket with watermelon and sunglasses on a red checked cloth.

column2: Watercolor of castle towers and stone walls rising behind tiled roofs, brick chimneys, and a wall-top planter of red flowers.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor in a cream mat with a blue inner border. Pale stone castle walls with a square crenellated tower and an arched Gothic window rise at upper right. Below them are a brown tiled roof, tall red brick chimneys, and a small paned window. In the foreground a brick wall carries a planter filled with red tulips, blue and white flowers, and a pink flowering shrub, with green foliage at left. The sky is blue with soft clouds. Signed "G Link 87" at lower left.

column2: Oil painting of a nighttime band concert in a lit octagonal bandstand in a park, with a seated audience and a figure with a child.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting in deep blues. A white octagonal bandstand with a pointed orange-brown roof and lacy trim glows with light at center; inside, a conductor with raised arm leads a group of musicians. An audience sits on benches in front, a large tree trunk stands in the left foreground, and at right a glowing street lamp lights a flowering tree. An adult and a small child, seen as dark silhouettes, walk hand in hand at lower right. Dark wooded hills rise behind under a blue night sky. Signed "G Link 76" at lower left.

column2: Oil painting of a small pale stucco church with a square tower, pointed dark roof, and red door on a rise under a grey sky.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting. A cream and pink-toned church stands on a small hill, seen from the front corner, with a square entrance tower topped by a steep dark shingled spire, a louvered belfry opening, a pointed-arch transom over a red door, and stone steps flanked by low piers. A brick chimney rises from the nave roof and arched windows line the side. A shrub with white blossoms grows at lower right, misty blue-grey trees surround the building, and a path climbs through yellow-green grass. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Oil still life of a large bouquet of yellow and orange lilies, daisies, and snapdragons in a dark glass vase on a wooden table.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting of a full, spreading bouquet in warm yellows and oranges: daylilies, yellow daisy-like flowers, small orange blooms, white daisies, tiny pale blue blossoms, and tall yellow snapdragon spikes. The flowers stand in a dark, rounded footed vase on a polished brown table where a few fallen petals lie. The background is soft blue-grey with patches of cream. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Oil still life of a watermelon wedge, a blue-and-white pitcher, a drinking glass, a peach in a bowl, a lemon, and a knife.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting in loose, bright brushwork. A thick wedge of red watermelon with black seeds and a dark green rind sits at center on a white cloth, with a knife and a lemon in front of it. Behind are a clear green-tinted glass tumbler and a yellow bowl holding a peach, and at right stands a large white pitcher with blue bands and a scalloped rim. A blue checked cloth lies under the white one, and the background is dappled yellow, green, and blue. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Oil painting of a large cream-colored English-style country house with a tiled roof and dormers behind a garden of delphiniums.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting. A two-story cream house with a steep red-brown tiled roof, four small dormers, tall brick chimneys, and many-paned windows stands across a green lawn, with a low tiled wing at left. Two small figures appear on the lawn, one near the door and one at far right. The foreground is filled with tall blue and purple delphiniums, pink hollyhocks, and white and yellow daisies. Large trees stand behind at left under a bright blue sky with white clouds.

column2: Oil painting of a small child in an oversized cowboy hat, blue vest, red plaid pants, and boots, with a scruffy dog at their feet.
column3: A tall, narrow oil painting. A young child stands on a brick walk, one hand raised to the brim of a very large, tall cream cowboy hat. The child wears a blue fleece-lined vest over a red shirt, red plaid trousers, and tan cowboy boots, and holds a small box in the other hand. A shaggy tan terrier with a red collar sits at lower left looking out at the viewer. Red geraniums grow at the bottom edge, with a brick step and red door frame at right against a grey and cream wall. Signed at lower left.

column2: Oil painting of the inside of a greenhouse filled with hanging baskets and tables of flowers, with shoppers and a woman watering plants.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting of a plant nursery greenhouse under an arched, light-filled roof. Hanging baskets overflowing with pink, red, white, and orange flowers and two large ferns fill the upper half. Below are benches of pink hydrangeas, red and white blooms, and orange lilies with yellow price signs. At left a blonde woman in white examines a tray of plants; at center a woman in glasses stands behind the hydrangeas; at lower right a woman in a blue dress, white apron, and white cap sprays water from a hose; other small figures appear in the distance. Signed at lower left.

column2: Oil painting of tall stone gate pillars marked "SMA" with open wrought-iron gates, and a yellow columned building beyond.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting on stretched canvas. Two large, pale stone gate pillars topped with carved finials flank a paved drive; each is inscribed "SMA". Ornate black wrought-iron gates stand open, with a matching iron fence and a third pillar at right. Through the gate are a yellow building with white columns, a pedimented doorway, and a grey roof, and a small red brick building at left. A leafy green tree rises at upper left against a blue sky with white clouds. Signed "G Link 77" at lower left.

column2: Oil painting of the front of a red brick building with arched blue-grey doors, flower pots, and a woman and two children outside.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting on stretched canvas showing the street-level facade of a red brick building numbered "117". Two arched doorways with blue-grey doors and an arched window are set in the wall, with three square windows above. Pots and beds of red, white, and blue flowers line the base. At left a blonde woman in white overalls and a red shirt stands with her back to the viewer, and at right a dark-haired child in blue stands beside a smaller blonde child in a light dress. Signed "G Link 76" at lower left.

column2: Oil painting of a hillside town with a green church spire, a white columned building with a cupola, and crowded brick buildings.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting on stretched canvas of a densely built townscape rising up a hill. At left a red brick church tower carries a tall green spire. On the hilltop sits a long cream and white building with tall columns and a small green-domed cupola, backed by dark green trees. Below, tightly packed brick and stucco buildings in red, ochre, yellow, and white step down the slope, with a grey pointed roof at center, a tall brick building along the right edge, and a few parked cars at the bottom. The sky is pale yellow and blue. Signed "G Link 76" at lower right.

column2: Oil painting of a large old tree with a rope swing hanging from a branch, beside a country road and fenced golden fields.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting dominated by a massive, gnarled tree with a thick, multi-colored trunk, spreading roots, and a canopy of green and yellow leaves. A simple board swing hangs on two long ropes from a branch at left. Behind the tree a grey road curves uphill at left, a wire fence with wooden posts crosses the middle distance, and golden fields with a second tree lie beyond. The lawn is green with deep shadow. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Oil painting of two old two-story storefront buildings, one red brick with green trim and one orange, on a wet street.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting on stretched canvas. Two adjoining commercial buildings face a rain-slick street that reflects them. The left building is red brick with a green cornice, green arched window frames, and green double doors, with trash cans at the curb. The right building is orange above and dark blue-grey at street level, with cream window surrounds and a dark doorway under a green and brown cornice. A small black cat walks along the sidewalk between them. A utility pole with wires stands at left and a street sign at right, under a cloudy grey sky. Signed "G Link 76" at lower right.

column2: Oil painting of a small stone outbuilding with a wood-shingled roof and plank door, beside a bent tree and tall grasses.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting on stretched canvas, in blue and gold tones. A low fieldstone building with a dark shingled gable roof, board gable end, weathered plank door, and one barred window stands at center. A curving tree trunk rises at right and bends a bare limb over the roof. Spiky grasses and iris-like leaves grow in the foreground, and trees with yellow and orange leaves show against a pale blue sky behind. Signed "G Link '82" at lower right.

column2: Oil painting looking down a sloping downtown street lined with storefronts toward a church spire and a large dome in haze.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting in soft, hazy greys and reds. A street descends between rows of multi-story brick and white commercial buildings with awnings and shop signs. Small figures walk the sidewalks, one with a dog, and a cyclist in a red shirt crosses the foreground; dark old-fashioned cars line the left curb beside a street lamp. In the distance a round turret with a conical roof, a tall thin spire, and a large pale dome topped with a statue rise against a blue-grey sky. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Watercolor of a yellow stucco house with a red tile roof and flower-filled window boxes above stone steps, with a woman climbing them.
column3: A portrait-format watercolor on cream paper. A two-story pale yellow house with a red clay-tile roof, green shutters, and a tiled porch roof on rough wooden posts stands at the top of a stone stairway. Window boxes and large pots overflow with red, yellow, and orange flowers, and iron grilles cover the lower windows. In the foreground a dark-haired woman in a blue skirt carries a basket of flowers up the steps beside a pale curving wall. Signed "G Link 86" at lower right; a pencil caption at lower left reads "House at the top of the stairs, Torremolinos, Spain".

column2: Watercolor of a red brick clock tower with a green dome rising beside brick and yellow buildings on a sloping street.
column3: A portrait-format watercolor within a pencil border. A tall, slender red brick tower with clock faces on two sides and a green onion-shaped dome with a finial stands at center, attached to a three-story brick building at right. Yellow and blue buildings recede down the street at left, and another yellow tower appears at far left. Two masses of green foliage flank a pale road in the foreground beneath a loosely washed blue sky.

column2: Oil painting of a curving railroad track and a long covered station platform with travelers, beside a red brick mill building.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting. A sweeping grey platform canopy on dark posts curves from the left foreground into the distance, following double railroad tracks that bend to the right past a rocky brown embankment. People wait on the platform with luggage and baggage carts, and a figure in a blue-grey coat and hat walks away from the viewer carrying a bag. Beyond the canopy stands a four-story red brick building with a sign reading "White Star Mills", next to grey mill buildings and white silos, with a tall utility pole against a pale cloudy sky. Signed "G Link 78" at lower right.

column2: Oil painting of a stone and timber park pavilion with two gabled roofs, surrounded by trees in yellow and red autumn color.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting on board. An open shelter with heavy stone piers and a dark shingled roof presents two gables with decorative white timber trusses. A small dark figure stands inside between the piers, and two small figures stand by a white fence at left. Tall trees in yellow-gold and red-orange foliage rise behind against a blue sky with soft clouds, a green shrub grows at right, and the foreground is grass and a pale path with autumn weeds. Signed "G Link 65" at lower left.

column2: Oil painting of a yellow building with a curved, white-columned two-story portico and iron railing above a terrace with chairs.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting. A semicircular portico with tall white columns and a heavy white entablature projects from a yellow building, with a black iron railing around its upper level. Below, two arched doorways and a hanging lantern open onto a terrace set with wrought-iron chairs and round tables. A stone staircase with a railing climbs at left beside a small red-leaved tree, and dark evergreens frame the edges under a blue sky. A faint signature is at lower left.

column2: Oil still life of a blue-and-white ginger jar holding dried silver seed pods and bare twigs, beside a wooden chest.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting in dark, warm tones. A rounded white ceramic jar with blue-grey decoration stands at left, holding stems of pale, translucent round seed pods and reddish bare branches. Behind it sits a brown wooden trunk with brass tacks and a slightly open lid. The objects rest on a pale cloth against a dark brown background, with a strip of patterned drapery at right. A faint signature is at lower left.

column2: Folk-art style oil painting of a dark-haired young child in a red dress and white pantalettes, holding an orange cat.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting in the manner of early American folk portraiture. A small child with dark, center-parted hair stands facing the viewer against a plain dark grey background. The child wears an off-the-shoulder red dress with full puffed sleeves and a lace-trimmed neckline, white pantalettes, and dark shoes with red laces, and holds a yellow-orange tabby cat across their body with both arms.

column2: Folk-art style oil painting of a large red house with a curved fence beside a harbor filled with sailing ships, captioned at the bottom.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting on unstretched canvas in the manner of an early American folk painting. A large two-story red house with white trim, a pedimented doorway, and a gambrel-roofed wing stands at left behind a curving white fence. At right a green harbor holds several sailing ships, one flying an American flag, with more sails on the horizon and a second red building at the far right. Small figures in dark clothing stand in the yard and on a wharf, and flocks of birds cross a pale, streaked sky. A dark band along the bottom carries the gold-lettered caption "A View of Mr. Joshua Winsor's House".

column2: Oil painting of a brown and white goat with long spotted ears eating from a plate on a wooden table inside a barn.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting in a narrow wooden frame. A brown goat with white patches, long drooping speckled ears, and a short upright tail stands in profile on a straw-covered floor, its head pushed past a post to eat from a white plate on a rough wooden table. Printed feed sacks hang on the grey board wall at upper left, a rag hangs from a nail at center, and a straw broom leans beside pale crocks at lower left. Signed "G Link" in red at lower right.

column2: Oil painting of a weathered barn at the end of a country lane, with autumn trees and a bank of orange flowers.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting in soft, hazy color. A grey-brown barn with a pale roof stands at center right at the end of a dirt lane lined with fence posts. A mass of orange flowers fills the right foreground beneath large dark trees, and slender trees with gold and orange leaves stand at left. The sky is streaked blue-grey and white, and the foreground is brown earth with touches of yellow and red blossoms. Signed "G Link" in red at lower right.

column2: Oil painting of a pond with white swans seen between two tall trees with golden autumn leaves.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting. Two tall trees with pale grey trunks and yellow-gold foliage frame the view from either side, their branches meeting overhead. Between them lies a still, pale blue-grey pond with one white swan near the front and two more farther back. Low blue hills line the horizon under a grey sky, and the banks and foreground are russet and brown with fallen leaves. A faint signature is at lower right.

column2: Pastel of a grey shingled cottage with blue shutters, a blue door, window boxes of red flowers, and a white picket fence.
column3: A landscape-format pastel on cream paper. A low, grey shingled Cape Cod cottage with a gabled front entry, bright blue door and shutters, red brick chimneys, and window boxes of red flowers sits behind a white picket fence. A lamp post stands at left beside a large tree trunk, and a pine tree rises in front of the house at center right, its branches spreading across the roof. Dark green trees fill the background and blue shadows fall across the sunlit lawn. Inscribed "G Link, Cape Cod 78" at lower right.

column2: Hexagonal painting on tan fabric of a white footed glass dish heaped with strawberries, with a pink rose, pansies, and grapes at its base.
column3: A painting on a hexagon-shaped piece of golden-tan velvet-like fabric. A tall white opalescent compote with a fluted bowl is piled with red strawberries and edged with blue-green leaves. Around its base lie a pink rose, white blossoms, blue forget-me-not-like flowers, yellow and purple pansies, green leaves, and a small bunch of purple grapes. Soft grey shading suggests a tabletop. A small signature is at lower right.

column2: Oil painting of a young girl in a white dress and black boots standing on a porch beside a wicker chair holding a doll.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting. A girl with long brown hair and a large white bow stands facing the viewer with a solemn expression, wearing a long-sleeved white dress with a tiered lace yoke, a gold necklace, black stockings, and black lace-up boots. Beside her at left a large doll with curly blonde hair and a grey dress with lace trim sits in an ornate wicker chair. The setting is a wooden porch with a white railing and post, a fern at lower right, and a view of green fields and blue mountains beyond. Signed "G Link" at lower left, with the word "MOTHER" lettered faintly on the floor.

column2: Oil painting of Santa Claus in a fur-trimmed red suit raising a metal tankard in one hand and holding a long clay pipe in the other.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting in deep reds and browns. A smiling Santa Claus with a full white beard, a red fur-trimmed cap decorated with a sprig of holly, and a red coat with a wide belt and brass buckle lifts a pewter tankard high with his right hand and holds a long-stemmed pipe in his left. He stands within a painted arch with a swirling grey-green and ochre background and ornate dark red framing with scroll and rosette decoration. Signed and dated "G Link 76" at lower right.

column2: Oil portrait in an eighteenth-century style of a man in a dark blue military coat with buff facings, gold buttons, and a white cravat.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting showing a man from the waist up, turned slightly to the left and looking at the viewer. He has dark hair drawn back in a queue and rosy cheeks, and wears a dark navy uniform coat with wide buff-yellow lapels and gold buttons, a buff waistcoat with gold embroidered edging, and a white ruffled cravat. The background is dark grey with a reddish tone at lower left. A faint signature is at lower right.

column2: Oil portrait in a nineteenth-century style of a woman in a white lace bonnet, wide white collar, and black dress, holding a pink rose.
column3: A portrait-format oil painting of a seated woman shown from the waist up, facing the viewer with a slight smile. Her dark hair is parted in the center under a white ruffled bonnet tied beneath her chin with a large white bow. She wears a black dress with a broad pale blue-white collar and holds a pink rose in her right hand. The background is warm brown, with a draped grey-rose curtain and tassel at right and part of a chair back at left.

column2: Watercolor of whitewashed houses with tiled roofs, laundry on a line, three figures at a doorway, and two chickens in the yard.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor on cream paper. Three pale grey and white houses with tan clay-tile roofs, one with upturned eaves, stand around an open yard. Red and blue laundry hangs on a line propped by a pole at left. Three figures, two in dark clothing and one in a red top, stand near a doorway at center. A red-brown chicken and a grey chicken stand in the foreground on pale yellow-green ground. The sky is a soft blue-violet wash. Inscribed at lower left "G Link '79, Cascais, Portugal".

column2: Pastel and watercolor of a large red brick house with dormers and porches behind a big bare-branched tree.
column3: A landscape-format work in pastel over watercolor wash on cream paper. A two-and-a-half-story red brick house with a grey roof, dormer window, brick chimneys, and white-trimmed windows stands at an angle, with a small front porch at right and a lower wing with a metal roof and porch at left. A massive bare tree with a grey trunk and spreading limbs rises in front of the house, with smaller bare trees, a green shrub, and brown bushes around it. The ground is washed in tan and the sky in pale blue. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Black-and-white studio portrait photograph of a smiling young woman with dark, curled shoulder-length hair.
column3: A portrait-format black-and-white studio photograph mounted in a cream mat. It shows the head and bare shoulders of a young woman facing the viewer with a broad smile. Her dark hair is swept back from her forehead and falls in soft curls to her shoulders. The background is plain and light, and the image fades softly toward the bottom in a vignette. A faint embossed studio mark is at the lower right of the print.

column2: Watercolor of a small red brick Cape Cod style house with a grey roof, a dormer, and a tall brick chimney, with shrubs in front.
column3: A landscape-format watercolor mounted in a tan mat. A one-and-a-half-story red brick house with a steep grey roof, a single white dormer, a tall exterior brick chimney at left, white-trimmed multi-pane windows, and a white front door stands on a pale lawn with green shrubs along the foundation. A small side porch is at right, and an evergreen bough hangs in from the upper left against a blue sky with white clouds. Signed "G Link '61" at lower right.

column2: Oil still life of two red tomatoes, a green bell pepper, and a yellow squash on a white cloth against a green background.
column3: A landscape-format oil painting in thick brushwork. A large red tomato sits at left and a smaller one at right, with a dark green bell pepper standing behind them and a yellow crookneck squash lying in front. They rest on a white cloth painted with heavy white and grey strokes, against an olive green background. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Sepia cabinet card photograph of a young girl in a white dress and dark stockings leaning against a wicker chair.
column3: A portrait-format sepia studio photograph mounted on a tan cabinet card. A small girl with long, light hair tied with a bow stands facing the camera with a serious expression, wearing a long-sleeved white dress with a ruffled yoke, dark stockings, and dark boots. She leans back against the seat of an ornate wicker chair. The print is faded, with a scratch across the upper right. The mount is printed at the bottom with the photographer's name in script and "Staunton, Va."

column2: Colored pencil drawing of a round white windmill with triangular cloth sails against blue shading, with a small dog lying nearby.
column3: A portrait-format colored pencil and ink drawing on cream paper. A squat, round whitewashed windmill with a dark conical cap, a small window, and a low doorway stands on a grassy rise ringed with stones. Its sails are triangular cloths rigged on long wooden spars radiating from the hub. Blue pencil hatching fills the sky behind the mill, a path leads to the door, and a small dark dog lies on the grass at right. Inscribed "Portugal Oct 79" at lower right.

column2: Watercolor of a beach with three umbrellas, people sitting on the sand, and children wading in the surf.
column3: Front of the work. A landscape-format watercolor on white paper showing a sandy beach and blue ocean under a cloudy grey-blue sky, with a low green headland on the horizon at left. A pink-brown umbrella lies tipped on the sand at left; at right stand a blue, red, and white umbrella and a yellow one. Several small figures sit on the sand, including one in a white hat, and two children wade at the water's edge. Dune grass is brushed into the foreground. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Back of the beach watercolor: a stained white board wrapped in plastic, held with strips of masking and duct tape, with a hanger.
column3: Back of the work. A white backing board, heavily foxed and stained, is wrapped in clear plastic film and held in place by many strips of yellowed masking tape and grey duct tape around the edges. A metal pull-tab ring is taped at the top center as a hanger. A paper label at lower right is handwritten "lgpst000021".

column2: Silhouette of a man in a tall top hat, facing left, in a round wooden frame.
column3: A small black bust silhouette on tan paper set in a round, turned wooden frame with a metal hanging loop. The figure faces left and wears a tall top hat with a narrow brim, a high collar, and a coat with pointed lapels. The initials "GL" are inked at lower right of the paper.

column2: Silhouette of a woman in a large bonnet with a bow, facing right, in a round wooden frame.
column3: A small black bust silhouette on tan paper set in a round, turned wooden frame that has a crack at lower right. The figure faces right and wears a deep, pointed bonnet trimmed with a sprig on top and tied with a ribbon bow at the back of the neck. The initials "GL" are inked at lower right of the paper.

column2: Silhouette of a man facing left with hair tied back in a queue with a ribbon, on stained cream paper.
column3: A black bust silhouette on a rectangular sheet of cream paper with brown water stains. The figure faces left in profile, with a prominent nose and chin, hair drawn back and tied at the nape with a ribbon bow, and a high-collared coat.

column2: Silhouette of a man facing right with a queue tied in a bow and a ruffled shirt front, on an oval sheet.
column3: A black bust silhouette painted on an oval sheet of tan paper with darkened edges. The figure faces right in profile and has hair tied back with a large ribbon bow. Fine lines left in reserve define a high coat collar, lapel, and seam, and a ruffled jabot projects from the chest.

column2: Silhouette of a woman facing left wearing a tall ruffled cap, on cream paper.
column3: A black bust silhouette on a rectangular sheet of cream paper with slight discoloration. The figure faces left in profile and wears a high, rounded mob cap with a frilled edge and a ruffle at the back of the neck, above a plain sloping bust line.

column2: Silhouette of a young woman facing left with her hair pinned up in a knot, on spotted cream paper.
column3: A black bust silhouette on a rectangular sheet of cream paper covered with pale brown spots and stains. The figure faces left in profile, with a slender neck, a short fringe at the forehead, and hair gathered into a looped bun at the back of the head.

column2: Silhouette of a man facing left with brushed-back hair, a high collar, and a ruffled shirt front, on spotted cream paper.
column3: A black bust silhouette on a nearly square sheet of cream paper with brown foxing spots. The figure faces left in profile with thick hair swept back. Lines left in reserve define a high standing shirt collar, a coat collar, and a broad lapel, and a ruffled shirt frill runs down the chest.

column2: Worn grey front cover of a spiral-bound sketchbook with a "Spiral Sketch Book" label.
column3: Front cover of a spiral-bound sketchbook, bound on the left. The grey-green board cover is scuffed and mottled. A printed label at lower right reads "Spiral Sketch Book" with a strip below reading 'No. 7191 - "Monterey" Drawing.' A handwritten Roman numeral "I" is at the upper right corner.

column2: Title page with the word "ART" in bold black block letters, "34-36" below, and the name "Gretchen Hitt".
