column3: A cream sketchbook page lettered by hand in black. "ART" appears in large block capitals at center, with "34-36" in smaller numerals beneath (the "36" in grey), and "GRETCHEN HITT" in block capitals at lower right.

column2: Faint pencil sketch, drawn upside down on the page, of a layered ruffled form, with handwritten notes above.
column3: A cream sketchbook page with the spiral binding at right. A light pencil drawing, inverted relative to the page, shows a tiered, scallop-edged shape resembling a ruffled costume or figure with dark shaded areas. Small upside-down pencil notes appear at the top, partly legible as "Santa" and "black shoes".

column2: Watercolor of a dark-haired woman with red and blue flowers in her hair, wearing a red and yellow dress and holding a red hibiscus.
column3: A stylized watercolor figure on a cream page. A smiling woman with long, curly black hair looks over her bare shoulder toward the viewer. Blue flowers and a large red hibiscus are tucked in her hair, and she holds another red hibiscus in her hand. She wears a strapless red dress with a bold yellow leaf pattern. Signed "Gretchen Hitt" at right and dated "'34" at the bottom.

column2: Black ink drawing of a woman's face with downcast eyes, wearing a striped spiral hat and round earrings.
column3: A bold, high-contrast ink drawing on a cream page in a 1930s fashion-illustration style. A woman's head tilts downward, with long lashes, dark lips, and half of her face in solid black shadow. She wears a small hat patterned with a black-and-white spiral and large round drop earrings. Signed "Gretchen Hitt '34" at lower right.

column2: Watercolor of a single yellow daffodil with long green leaves, labeled "Jonquils".
column3: A watercolor on a cream page of one pale yellow daffodil with a deeper yellow ruffled trumpet, rising from a clump of tall, blue-green strap leaves with a patch of green ground wash at right. Labeled "Jonquils" in pencil below, and signed "Gretchen Hitt '35 March" at lower right.

column2: Pen drawing of a three-masted sailing ship under full sail seen head-on, inside a ruled border.
column3: An ink drawing within a rectangular ruled frame on a cream page. A square-rigged ship with tiers of billowing sails and a pennant at the masthead sails directly toward the viewer. Diagonal hatching fills the sky and the ship's dark reflection ripples across the water below. Signed "Gretchen Hitt March '35" at left inside the frame.

column2: Pencil drawing of two lily-like flowers with spotted petals on tall stems with narrow leaves.
column3: A pencil drawing on a cream page of two speckled, open flowers on slender stems, one above the other, with a few long narrow leaves. Horizontal pencil shading across the background suggests sky or water. Signed "Gretchen Hitt May 1935" at lower right.

column2: Pencil sketch of a group of steep-roofed cottages with tall trees behind and a path leading to an arched door.
column3: A pencil drawing on a cream page of several small houses with steep shingled gables and a tall chimney marked with an "S"-shaped iron, clustered among cypress-like and rounded trees. A straight path leads up to the arched doorway of the central house, and broad horizontal strokes shade the lawn and sky. Signed "Gretchen Hitt July 29, 1935" at lower right.

column2: Pencil drawing of a stone picnic table and two benches under trees, captioned "Lytle Creek (Picnic)".
column3: A pencil drawing on a page turned sideways, with the spiral binding along the top. A heavy concrete or stone picnic table with a bench on each side stands on grass beneath two large tree trunks with drooping foliage, with shrubs in the background. Captioned "Lytle Creek (Picnic)" at the bottom and initialed "G.L.H. Sept - 35" at lower right.

column2: Very faint, unfinished pencil sketch of a tree trunk with the outline of a building behind it.
column3: A cream sketchbook page with the binding at right, bearing a few light pencil lines: the two edges of a tall tree trunk at left, sprigs of foliage, the outline of a small gabled building and a tall post at right, and a suggestion of ground at the base.

column2: Pencil studies of two classical column capitals, labeled Ionic and Doric, under the heading "Columns".
column3: A cream sketchbook page headed "Columns" in pencil. At upper left is a drawing of an Ionic capital with scrolled volutes above a short shaft and molded base, labeled "Ionic Capital and Base (Lycia)". Below it is a Doric capital on a fluted shaft, labeled "Doric". The right half of the page is blank.

column2: Pencil drawing of a castle-like building with crenellated towers, exterior stairs, and the letters "KP" on a wall.
column3: A pencil drawing on a cream page with the binding at right. A round tower with battlements and narrow windows rises at center, with a square battlemented tower marked "KP" at left, a dark shaded tree behind, and a zigzag exterior staircase climbing at right to a covered entrance. Water ripples are indicated at the base. Signed "Gretchen Hitt" at lower left.

column2: Light pencil drawing of a spray of roses with buds, leaves, and small five-petaled blossoms.
column3: A delicate pencil outline drawing on a cream page of a curving rose stem with two full blooms, one drooping, along with a bud, leaves, and a small sprig of simple five-petaled flowers at right. Signed "Gretchen Hitt April 19, '36" at lower right.

column2: Pencil drawing of a long house with two chimneys behind dense trees and shrubs, with billowing clouds above.
column3: A shaded pencil drawing on a cream page of a gabled house with two brick chimneys and a lower wing at left, largely screened by dark evergreens, a round-crowned tree, and a hedge. Rounded cumulus clouds rise behind the roof. Initialed "G.L.H. April 30, 1936" at lower right.

column2: Soft, heavily shaded pencil sketch of a tree in a clearing surrounded by drooping foliage.
column3: A loose pencil landscape on a cream page with the binding at right. A tree with a double trunk stands at center casting a dark shadow on the ground, framed by masses of hanging foliage at left and right, with a glimpse of distant water or hills at upper left. Initialed "G.L.H. '36" at lower right.

column2: Blue pencil drawing of a Western saddle inside a ruled border with clipped corners.
column3: A blue pencil outline drawing on a cream page of a Western riding saddle seen from the side, with a tall horn, raised cantle, and leather ties hanging from round conchos. It is enclosed in a rectangular blue border with two diagonal corners. Signed "Gretchen Hitt" inside the border with "'35" beside it.

column2: Pencil sketches of two tree trunks with sparse foliage and two small shrubs.
column3: A cream page with the binding at right, holding several pencil studies: a large, rough-barked tree with a forked crown and a broken limb at upper left, a slender, mottled trunk with drooping needles at right, and two low, spiky bushes.

column2: Faint pencil sketches of a rose, a flower spike, and part of a basket, headed "Las Flores".
column3: A cream page headed "Las Flores" in pencil. Light outline sketches show a rose on a leafy stem at top, a tall spike of small blossoms at center left, and the curved rim and woven base of a basket at right, left unfinished.

column2: Pencil drawing of a small shed with a ladder leaning against it, between a leaning tree and a group of bushy trees.
column3: A shaded pencil landscape on a page turned sideways, with the spiral binding at the bottom. A low, flat-roofed shed with a dark doorway and a ladder against its wall stands on a slight rise. A large tree with a slanting trunk and drooping foliage fills the left, and smaller full trees stand at right. Initialed "GH" at lower left.

column2: Pencil drawing of a low house among palms and trees behind a stone-edged bank, captioned "Mr. Sprague's House".
column3: A pencil drawing across the top of a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. A shingle-roofed house with a stone chimney sits among palm trees, shrubs, and a small outbuilding, above a border of rounded stones. Captioned "Mr. Sprague's House" at left and signed "Gretchen Hitt" at center right. The lower half of the page is blank.

column2: Pencil drawing of a smiling young woman in a beret, short pleated skirt, and puff-sleeved jacket, with a stick over her shoulder.
column3: A full-length pencil figure drawing in a 1930s pin-up or fashion style on a cream page with the binding at right. A woman with curled hair and a beret stands with legs apart, one hand on her hip, holding a pennant or closed parasol over her shoulder. She wears a dark vest with puffed sleeves, a striped scarf, gloves, and a short striped pleated skirt, with a bag hanging at her side. Initialed and dated "Aug '36" at lower right.

column2: Small pencil sketch of a woman with glasses seated in a wooden armchair, resting her head on her hand, captioned "Mother".
column3: A pencil sketch in the upper left of a cream page. A woman with short curly hair and round glasses sits in a slat-backed armchair, leaning her head on her right hand. She wears a short-sleeved belted dress with a V neck and strapped shoes. Tall grass-like strokes rise beside the chair. Captioned "Mother" and dated "June 12, '36".

column2: Pencil profile drawing of a woman with her head tilted back and eyes closed, with wavy hair and a hand at her collar.
column3: A pencil drawing on a cream page with the binding at right, in a glamorous 1930s illustration style. A woman is shown in left profile with her chin raised, eyes closed, and long lashes; her wavy hair is shaded dark and falls to her shoulders. One hand lightly holds the collar of her garment, which is only outlined. Signed "Gretchen Hitt Aug '36".

column2: Pencil sketch of a woman lying asleep on a sofa with shoes and a bowl on the floor, captioned "Mother".
column3: A pencil drawing on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. A figure lies stretched out on a long upholstered sofa with one arm raised over the head and a patterned cushion behind. A pair of shoes and a low footed bowl sit on the floor in front. Captioned "Mother" at lower left and signed "Gretchen Hitt" at right.

column2: Simple pencil outline of three tulips with leaves.
column3: A light pencil outline drawing on a cream page with the binding at right, showing two open tulips on tall stems, a smaller bud at left, and a few leaves, rising from a ruled baseline with a short vertical line at left.

column2: Three quick pencil sketches of a cat lying stretched out, headed "Los Gatos" and "Minute Sketches".
column3: A cream page headed "Los Gatos" at upper left and "Minute Sketches" at upper right. Three pencil studies show a cat lying down: seen from behind at top, sleeping stretched on its side at center, and sprawled away from the viewer at bottom. Initialed "GH".

column2: Pencil drawing of a chubby, smiling baby sitting with one arm raised behind its head.
column3: A pencil drawing on a cream page with the binding at right, in a sweet illustration style. A baby with wispy curls, large eyes, and a small smile sits turned toward the viewer, one hand raised to the back of the head and the other resting on the knee, with a shaded cushion behind. Initialed "G.L.H. Aug '36".

column2: Faint pencil sketch of a man in a slouch hat and double-breasted overcoat.
column3: A small, light pencil sketch at the center of a cream page showing a man from the hips up, looking down and to the left. He wears a brimmed hat tilted on his head and a long buttoned coat with a wide collar. The lower part of the figure fades out unfinished.

column2: Pen and ink drawing of a wooden shed with an open plank door, with a bush growing on its roofline.
column3: A cross-hatched ink drawing on a cream page with the binding at right. A small board shed with a sloping roof stands with its braced plank door swung open at left, revealing a dark interior with a rounded object inside. A latch hangs on the door frame, a shrub grows at the left corner, foliage rises behind the roof, and a block lies on the ground in front. Initialed "G.L.H. Aug. '36".

column2: Three pencil sketches of cats: a head in profile, a seated cat looking back, and a crouching cat.
column3: A cream page with three quick pencil studies of cats. At upper left is a large head and neck in profile facing right; at center a cat sits with its back to the viewer and turns its head to look over its shoulder; at lower right a cat crouches low facing the viewer.

column2: Pencil portrait of a woman with dark hair pulled back, a flower behind her ear, and a high fastened collar.
column3: A pencil drawing on a cream page with the binding at right. A woman's face fills the upper page, looking slightly to the left with dark eyes and full lips; her dark, center-parted hair is drawn back into a low bun with a cluster of flowers at her right ear. She wears a garment with a high mandarin-style collar closed with frog fastenings. Shading surrounds the shoulders. Initialed "G.L.H. '36".

column2: Pencil sketches of chickens in several poses, with studies of animal legs and a bird's foot.
column3: A cream page of light pencil studies. Four hens are drawn standing, walking, and pecking at the ground. At the top are a pair of hoofed animal legs and a single bird's foot, and at lower left is another small study of a hoof.

column2: Pencil drawing of a hibiscus flower with buds and leaves on a stem.
column3: A soft pencil drawing on a cream page with the binding at right. A large open hibiscus bloom with broad overlapping petals and a projecting stamen faces right, on an upright stem with several pointed buds above and large leaves below. Signed "Gretchen Hitt '37".

column2: Pencil drawing of a curly-haired toddler sitting on a bench and waving one arm.
column3: A pencil drawing on a cream page of a small child with curly hair seated on a low bench, turned to the right with mouth open in a smile and left arm raised in a wave. The child wears a short romper with a collar and bow, ankle socks, and strapped shoes. Light shading rises behind. Initialed at lower right.

column2: Pencil landscape of a tall tree with drooping branches beside a winding road, with a small house and hills beyond.
column3: A pencil drawing on a cream page with the binding at right. A slender tree with feathery, hanging foliage stands in the left foreground beside a low shrub. A road curves away past it toward a tiny house sheltered by a round tree, with rolling hills behind. Initialed "G.L.H. '36".

column2: Pencil sketch of two people lying on the sand beneath a beach umbrella, captioned "Huntington Beach".
column3: A pencil sketch across the top of a cream page. Two sunbathers lie on their stomachs side by side under a large striped umbrella tilted on the sand, one in a dark swimsuit. Waves break behind them, a small ship sits on the horizon, and a cloud is outlined above. Captioned "Huntington Beach" and initialed "G.L.H. '36". The lower page is blank.

column2: Pencil landscape of a tall pine on a hillside beside a large rock, with a path winding below.
column3: A pencil drawing on a cream page with the binding at right. A tall tree with a bare trunk and a spreading crown of needles grows on a slope beside a shaded, pointed boulder or shrub. A path curves along the lower left past a small bush, and low hills and an island lie on the horizon. Initialed "G.L.H. '36".

column2: Pencil sketch of an arcaded pier building with towers above breaking waves and gulls, captioned "Huntington Pier".
column3: A light pencil drawing on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. A long structure on tall arched supports stands in the surf, topped with gabled roofs, small spires, and a cross-like mast, with stepped buildings behind at right. Waves roll in the foreground and several gulls fly over the water. Captioned "Huntington Pier" and initialed "G.L.H. '36".

column2: Watercolor of a canna lily with yellow petals spotted red and a crimson center, on a green stem with leaves.
column3: A watercolor on a cream page with the binding at right. A flower cluster with deep crimson upper petals and yellow lower petals speckled with red tops a thick green stem. Broad blue-green leaves streaked with purple spread from the stem below. Initialed "G.L.H. Aug '36" at lower right.

column2: Pencil sketch of a tall waterfall dropping down a rock face, captioned "San Antonio Falls".
column3: A light pencil drawing on a cream page. Water falls in long vertical strokes from a notch at upper right down a cliff to a small pool edged with rocks. Spiky yucca-like plants dot the slopes on either side and a dark bush stands at lower right. Captioned "San Antonio Falls".

column2: Pencil drawing of a log cabin with a tall stone chimney among large pine trees, captioned "Our Cabin".
column3: A pencil drawing on a cream page with the binding at right. A cabin with a large fieldstone chimney on its gable end stands behind two thick tree trunks, with tall conifers and a mountain outline behind. Captioned '"OUR CABIN" W.T. and ME' and initialed "G.L.H. July '36". A small outlined shoe-like doodle is at lower right.

column2: Pencil drawing of a seated showgirl with curly hair and a feathered headdress, in a spangled two-piece costume.
column3: A pencil figure drawing in a 1930s pin-up style on a cream page. A woman with short curls and a plumed headpiece sits with one knee raised and one leg extended, resting her chin on her hand. She wears a sequined bra top with puffed sleeves, matching shorts trimmed with feathers, and strapped heels. Initialed "G.L.H. July '36".

column2: Pencil drawing of a smiling woman holding out the tiered, polka-dot skirt of a long ruffled dress.
column3: A pencil figure drawing in a 1930s illustration style on a cream page with the binding at right. A woman with waved dark hair tilts her head and smiles, holding the sides of a full-length halter dress with a belted waist and a wide skirt of dotted, ruffled tiers. Diagonal shading fills the background at left. Initialed "G.L.H. July '36".

column2: Pencil drawing of a dancer in a tiered ruffled dress with her arms raised to one side and an ornament in her curled hair.
column3: A small pencil figure drawing on a cream page in a 1930s illustration style. A smiling woman in a Spanish-style costume poses mid-dance with both hands lifted beside her face. She wears a tall comb or flowers in her curled hair, a short ruffled capelet, and a long skirt of four flounced tiers with a sash, one pointed shoe showing beneath. Initialed "G.L.H. Aug. 1, '36".

column2: Pencil drawing of a smiling woman in a sailor-style outfit with wide-leg trousers, pulling on a rope.
column3: A pencil figure drawing on a cream page with the binding at right. A woman with wavy shoulder-length hair looks over her shoulder at the viewer while hauling on a thick rope that runs diagonally across the page. She wears a short-sleeved top with a sailor collar and an emblem on the sleeve, and high-waisted, wide-legged trousers. Initialed "G.L.H. Aug '36" at lower right.

column2: Unfinished pencil outline of large tree trunks with part of a house at left.
column3: A light pencil outline sketch on a cream page. The broad, forked trunk of a tree fills the center, with a second trunk and a bare-branched tree to the right. At left is the corner of a small building with a chimney and a window. Sweeping lines indicate ground and paths.

column2: Faint pencil outline of a small log cabin among trees with an evergreen behind.
column3: A light pencil outline sketch on a cream page with the binding at right. A small cabin with a pitched roof and log walls sits at center between tall bare tree trunks, with a conifer outlined at right and the edge of another structure at left.

column2: Pencil drawing of a stone church with a steep roof, arched entry porch, and small belfry, captioned "Old Stone Church, Staunton, Va."
column3: A pencil line drawing on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. A church is seen from a front corner, with a steep main gable, a gabled porch with a large round arch at right, a small louvered belfry on the ridge, and vines climbing the walls. Signed "G Link '76" at lower left and captioned "Old Stone Church Staunton, Va" at the bottom.

column2: Blue ballpoint pen drawing of a bird perched on a domed fence post with a birdhouse attached, captioned "Card from Jennie".
column3: A blue ballpoint drawing on a cream page. A small bird sits on top of a ribbed, dome-shaped finial on a wooden post. A birdhouse with a peaked roof hangs on the post, with another bird looking out of its round hole, and a lattice fence panel extends to the right. Cloud outlines float behind. Signed "G. Link Sept 2011" and captioned "Card from Jennie".

column2: Worn grey back cover of the spiral-bound sketchbook with a small white label.
column3: Back cover of the sketchbook, with the spiral binding at right. The grey-green board is scuffed, mottled, and stained at the upper right. A small white paper label at lower left is handwritten "S1".

column2: Teal front cover of a "Sketch Diary" spiral sketchbook, printed with a hand drawing a line with a pencil.
column3: Front cover of a small spiral-bound sketchbook, bound on the left. The teal cover is printed in black with a hand holding a pencil that has drawn a long looping line, the title "sketch diary", the Skylight Studio logo, and "5 1/2 in. x 8 1/2 in. 70 sheets". A handwritten Roman numeral "II" is at the upper right.

column2: Handwritten title page reading "Window Sketches 1977-81, G. Link" with a list of places.
column3: A cream page with the binding at right, written in brown ink. The heading reads "Window Sketches 1977 - 81 G. Link". Below is a list of places: Spain, England, Scotland, Cape Cod '78, Florida, Portugal, Ireland, Fairfield Mts N.C., Hilton Head, Savannah, Charlestown S.C., New England '81, Cape Cod, Nantucket.

column2: Brown ink and wash drawing of ornate Spanish rooftops with urn-shaped finials and a pedimented doorway, Seville.
column3: A sepia pen and marker drawing on a cream page. A baroque gable with a triangular pediment and a tall dark door is crowned by a large urn-shaped finial, flanked by two pointed turrets with ball tops, with a tiled roof at left and a small dome at right. Inscribed "Seville 77 SPAIN G Link" at lower right.

column2: Ballpoint pen drawing of a Spanish building with two tiers of arcades and a curved gable, Torremolinos.
column3: A densely hatched pen drawing on a cream page. A building with two stories of round-arched loggias and a scrolled baroque gable stands at left, with a stairway descending in front. A tall block with square windows and a tiled roofline rises behind, and a balcony with a potted palm projects at right. Inscribed "G Link Torremolinos Oct 77 SPAIN".

column2: Colored pencil drawing of a stone church tower with a pointed roof above crenellated walls, Toledo, Spain.
column3: A pen and colored pencil drawing on a cream page in soft browns, blues, and greens. A square tower with arched belfry openings and a steep spire rises above battlemented stone walls. Cypress trees and shrubs grow at the foot of the walls, and a rocky bank and water lie in the foreground. Inscribed "Toledo, Spain G Link '77".

column2: Marker and colored pencil landscape of a rocky mountain above brown hills and a small white village, on the road to Granada.
column3: A brown pen and colored pencil drawing on a cream page. A pale, craggy mountain rises against a blue hatched sky. Below it lie rolling brown and tan hills with dark shrubs, a cluster of low buildings at right, and tufts of green grass in the foreground. Inscribed "On road to Granada G Link Oct 77".

column2: Colored pencil view through a dark stone arch of towers and tiled roofs at the Alhambra, Granada.
column3: A pen and colored pencil drawing on a cream page. A heavy, shaded horseshoe arch frames a view of square crenellated towers, tiled pavilion roofs, arched windows, and stepped walls in warm tan and brown under a blue sky. Inscribed "Grenada Spain The Alhambra G Link 77" at lower left.

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of ornate London rooftops with curved gables, scroll brackets, and a tall window.
column3: A brown pen drawing with blue and red colored pencil on a cream page. It shows the upper story of a building with a large multi-pane window, heavy pilasters ending in scrolled brackets, curving Dutch-style gables, a brick chimney with an arched cap, and a television aerial against a sky with outlined clouds. Inscribed "G Link 78" and "From Hotel St Ermins window London".

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a red brick gable topped by an arched stone cupola, St Ermin's, London.
column3: A black pen drawing with red and blue colored pencil on a cream page. A steep brick gable with a tall narrow window is crowned by a small open arched turret with a domed top. Slate roofs and chimneys extend behind, and a large arched window with small panes is at the bottom. Inscribed "St Ermin's G Link" and "London '78".

column2: Colored pencil drawing of a tall Gothic church spire against a blue sky with clouds and birds, Bristol.
column3: A brown pen and colored pencil drawing on a cream page. A slender yellow-tinted stone spire topped with a cross rises from a tower with pointed windows, corner pinnacles, and a pierced parapet. Blue shading, outlined clouds, and four flying birds fill the sky. Inscribed "G Link 78" at lower left and "Bristol Eng." at lower right.

column2: Grey pencil drawing of a tall church spire and tower beside a Gothic nave, with houses on a hill, Bristol.
column3: A soft pencil drawing with touches of orange and blue colored pencil on a cream page. A needle-like spire with a cross tops a tall tower with lit windows. At left are the roof, traceried window, and porch of the church, and at right a hillside with small houses and trees. Signed "G Link" at lower left and faintly inscribed "Bristol".

column2: Dark ink and colored pencil drawing of a church spire in silhouette against a sunset sky, with lit windows.
column3: A black pen drawing with colored pencil on a cream page. A tall spire and church stand in near-solid black against a sky shaded from lavender to yellow and pink at the horizon. Windows glow orange in the tower, and at right the dark rooftops of a town, round trees, and a distant tower are outlined. Inscribed "Bristol 78 G Link" at lower right.

column2: Brown ink drawing of a Gothic church with a tall spire seen from above, with a hillside town behind, Bristol.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A large church with traceried pointed windows, buttresses, and a tall central spire stands above a curving road where a small car is parked. At right, houses and trees climb a hill to a tower on the skyline. Clouds and birds are outlined in the sky. Inscribed "Hotel window Bristol England G Link 78".

column2: Colored pencil view over slate roofs, chimneys, and a turret to green fields, a village, and hills, Edinburgh.
column3: A brown pen and colored pencil drawing on a cream page. In the foreground are blue-grey slate roofs with a dormer and weathervane, tall chimney pots, a half-timbered gable, and a round turret with a conical roof above arched stone windows. Beyond lie bright green fields, a village with a church spire, and distant hills under a pale sky. Inscribed "Edinburgh '78 G Link" vertically at lower right.

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a stone figure holding a shield on a pillar, beside a sign reading "St Ermins".
column3: A black pen drawing with pink, blue, and green colored pencil on a cream page. A carved heraldic beast sits upright on a square pillar, holding a large blank shield in front of an arched window in a pink brick wall. A sign at upper right reads "ST ERMINS", and a leafy shrub grows at lower left. Inscribed "London G Link 78" at lower right.

column2: Green and blue pen drawing of a long straight avenue between rows of trees leading to a distant castle, Windsor.
column3: A drawing in green and blue pen with yellow and orange colored pencil on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. A broad path runs straight from the foreground between lawns and bands of trees to a castle with towers on the horizon, under a large sky of outlined clouds. Inscribed "Royal Mile Winsor Castle G Link 78" at lower left.

column2: Brown ink and colored pencil street scene of a crenellated stone gateway with a statue, timbered shops, and pedestrians, Salisbury.
column3: A brown pen drawing with colored pencil on a cream page. A narrow street passes under a medieval stone gate with battlements, small windows, and a statue in a niche above the arch. At right are jettied, yellow-plastered shop fronts with a hanging lantern. Several people walk in the street and a car is seen through the arch. Inscribed "High Street Gate, Salisbury G Link '78".

column2: Brown ink drawing of an English stone gatehouse with an arched passage, flanked by old buildings, chimneys, and a spire.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. A gabled stone gatehouse with a pointed window above a wide archway stands at center, joined to stone buildings with tiled roofs and tall chimneys. A church spire rises at left behind a hanging inn sign, a lamp post and a standing figure are at right, and the street is cobbled. Inscribed "G Link England 78".

column2: Faint blue pen sketch of the same English stone gatehouse and street, reversed left to right.
column3: A very pale blue pen drawing on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. It shows a gabled gatehouse with an archway, adjoining stone buildings with chimneys, a spire at right, a lamp post, and a standing figure at left. It appears to be a mirror-image offset or tracing of the drawing on the facing page.

column2: Black ink drawing of a twisting, leaning tree beside a pond with a shingled cottage behind, Cape Cod.
column3: A bold black pen drawing on a cream page. A tree with a thick, curving trunk leans from lower right to upper left, its branches carrying clumps of foliage. Behind it at right is part of a shingled house with a window, and at left a pond with reflections and a far treeline. Inscribed "G Link Cape Cod Sept '78".

column2: Brown marker sketch of a beach town street with low buildings, palm trees, parked cars, and signs, Daytona Beach.
column3: A loose brown marker drawing on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. Low roofs, a large flat-fronted building, and a high-rise at left stand along a road with cars. Tall signs include a sunburst sign and one reading "Winn Dixie". Palm trees are at left and birds and clouds in the sky. Inscribed "Dayton Beach 1979" at lower left.

column2: Black ink drawing looking down a steep street between houses toward the sea, with people carrying umbrellas, Cascais.
column3: A black pen drawing on a cream page with the binding at right. A narrow street drops between tiled roofs and chimneys, with small figures walking under umbrellas and a parked car. Tall conifers and a church with a cross rise beyond, and a ship sits on the sea at the horizon. A bare tree is at lower left. Inscribed "G Link street scene from Hotel Cascais Oct 79 Portugal".

column2: Vivid oil pastel drawing of yellow houses with red tile roofs among bright green trees, Cascais, Portugal.
column3: A colorful oil pastel drawing on a cream page. Large red-orange tiled roofs cover a yellow house with a blue shuttered window at upper right and a smaller building at lower left. Bright green and blue foliage fills the space between them, with a small tree at center. Inscribed "G Link Hotel window Cascais Portugal Oct 79" at lower left.

column2: Marker and colored pencil view over the red rooftops of a seaside town with tall pines and ships on the sea, Cascais.
column3: A brown marker drawing with colored pencil on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the bottom. A dense cluster of houses with red tile roofs, a domed tower, and tall Norfolk pine-like trees fills the page, with a street at right where figures and a dog walk. Beyond is blue sea with two ships. Inscribed "G Link Cascais '79".

column2: Brown pencil sketch of an older woman in a dark headscarf and shawl smiling from a window, Cascais, Portugal.
column3: A brown colored pencil drawing on a cream page with the binding at right. A woman wearing a dark scarf over her head and a dark shawl is framed in a cross-hatched window opening, facing the viewer with a smile. The wall and sill are loosely indicated. Inscribed "Cascais Portugal 79" and signed "G Link".

column2: Pen and colored pencil sketches of two small children, one in plaid shorts and one in a blue dress, captioned "Portugese Children".
column3: A cream page with two small figure studies in black pen and colored pencil. At top a curly-haired child with rosy cheeks stands facing the viewer in a blue sweater, red-and-blue plaid shorts, and dark boots. Below, a child with short dark hair is seen from behind, looking to the left, wearing a long-sleeved blue dress and ankle boots. Captioned in pencil "Portugese Children".

column2: Pen and colored pencil view from above of white houses with red tile roofs and a lane where two people walk with umbrellas.
column3: A blue-black pen drawing with colored pencil on a cream page. White houses with red tiled roofs and a tall square chimney fill the foreground. A brown lane curves uphill between green shrubs and trees, with two small figures under umbrellas, toward a group of white houses on the hilltop. Inscribed "Hotel balcony Albafaria Portugal 79".

column2: Brown ink studies of four decorative Portuguese chimneys, captioned "Chimneys, Albufiera, Portugal".
column3: A cream page with four brown pen drawings of ornamental chimney tops: a round lantern-like one with vertical slots, a square one with pierced patterns and a pyramid cap, a tall square one with a ball finial, and a larger tapering one with slotted openings. Captioned in pencil "Chimneys Albafiera, Portugal".

column2: Brown ink drawing of a tall narrow house with a curved tile roof, balcony, and flag, with a woman waiting at the door, Albufeira.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A three-story whitewashed building with an upswept tiled roof, a dormer, decorative window surrounds, and an iron balcony stands on a cobbled corner. A flag flies from a pole at right. A woman in dark clothes stands at the doorway holding a bag, and another figure walks down the lane at left. Inscribed "Waiting for the bus Albufiera, Portugal G Link Oct. 79".

column2: Faint blue reversed image of the tall house with a flag and waiting figure.
column3: A pale blue, mirror-image impression on a cream page with the binding at right. It repeats the drawing of the tall house with a tiled roof, balcony, flagpole, and figure at the door from the facing page, including its caption in reverse, and appears to be an offset or tracing.

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a row of trees along a stone wall with yellow houses behind, Galway, Ireland.
column3: A black pen drawing with colored pencil on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. Several slender trees with green and blue foliage stand in a line on a sloping lawn edged by a low stone wall. Behind them are yellow houses with red and grey roofs. Inscribed "G Link Galway, Ireland Sept 80 Hotel window".

column2: Soft colored pencil drawing of a white house with a red roof among trees with mountains behind, Westport, Ireland.
column3: A pen and colored pencil drawing on a cream page in pale greens, blues, and lavender. A two-story white house with a red-brown roof, chimneys, and a low front wing sits behind a hedge. Tall trees stand to the left with small figures on a path, and soft mountains rise behind. Inscribed "Westport Ire Sept 80 G Link".

column2: Brown pencil drawing of a stone bridge with two arches over a river, with a church spire and houses behind, Westport.
column3: A brown colored pencil drawing on a cream page. A humpbacked stone bridge with two round arches spans a river in the foreground, with reflections below. Behind it rise a tall, slender church spire, two gabled houses, and bushy trees, with birds in the sky. Inscribed "G Link Westport '80 Ireland".

column2: Brown ink and blue pencil view over slate rooftops and chimneys to a bay, an island with a cottage, and distant hills, Sligo.
column3: A brown pen drawing with blue and green colored pencil on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. Houses with slate roofs and smoking chimneys line the foreground. Beyond them stretches blue water with gulls, a low green headland with a white cottage, and a far shoreline with a town beneath hills. Inscribed "Sligo Ire '80 G Link".

column2: Brown ink and blue pencil view over rooftops to a wide bay with flat-topped mountains beyond, Sligo, Ireland.
column3: A brown pen drawing with blue colored pencil on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. Roofs and chimneys among bushes fill the lower page. A broad blue bay with long spits of land lies beyond, backed by a flat-topped mountain at left and a range of hills. Inscribed "Sligo Ireland Sept '80 G Link Hotel window".

column2: Pen drawing of two tall red-and-white striped smokestacks above rooftops and trees beside the sea, Dublin.
column3: A blue-black pen drawing with red, green, and blue pen on a cream page. Two very tall chimneys banded in red and white rise from a power station, trailing smoke into the sky. Below are green trees, red-roofed houses, and a small tower with a green cap, with blue water and a dark far shore behind. Inscribed "G Link Dublin Ire '80 Hotel window".

column2: Black ink drawing of a tall narrow stone house with chimneys beside a walled yard, with rooftops and a harbor beyond, Wexford.
column3: A black pen drawing with a touch of blue pencil on a cream page. A three-story house with a slate roof, tall chimneys, and arched ground-floor openings stands at right behind a stone gate pier and iron gates. A lower building with a slate roof is at left, weeds grow in the yard, and a strip of blue water shows beyond distant roofs. Inscribed "Wexford, Ire 1980 G Link".

column2: Pen and colored pencil view down onto slate roofs, a stuccoed building with a gabled wing, and a flowering garden, Wexford.
column3: A black pen drawing with colored pencil on a cream page. Seen from above, long slate roofs slant across the center below a tall tan building with small windows and a projecting gabled bay. A bare-branched tree rises at left, and pink flowers and vines grow over the wall at the bottom. Inscribed "G Link Wexford, Ire. Hotel window '80".

column2: Colored pencil landscape of a cottage beneath a tall tree on a green hillside with grazing cattle and mountains, Bantry, Ireland.
column3: A pen and colored pencil drawing on a cream page. A tall tree with layered blue-green foliage rises along the right side above a small cottage with red-trimmed windows and a path lined with flowers. Green pasture dotted with dark cattle climbs to a white building on a ridge, with lavender mountains beyond. Inscribed "Bantry, Ireland '80" and signed "G Link".

column2: Colored pencil landscape of a blue mountain above dark evergreens, leafy trees, and a wooden gate on a lane, Killarney.
column3: A pen and colored pencil drawing on a cream page. A rounded blue-violet mountain rises under a sky with outlined clouds. Below it a dark band of conifers stands behind pale green trees, a thatched or shingled shelter, a rail fence, and a lane curving into the foreground. Inscribed "Kilarney Ireland '80" and signed "G Link".

column2: Brown ink and green pencil drawing of a large branching tree with houses on a hillside behind and people on a path, Limerick.
column3: A brown pen drawing with green colored pencil on a cream page. A big tree with a thick, multi-stemmed trunk fills the page, its green canopy spreading across the top. Through its branches are rows of houses stepping up a hill. At the bottom a path with two walking figures, a lamp post, a parked bicycle, and round shrubs are drawn. Inscribed "Limerick, Ireland Oct 80" and signed "G Link".

column2: Brown ink drawing of a wooden lodge with a steep shingled roof and balcony railing, with mountains beyond, North Carolina.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A chalet-style building with vertical board siding and a broad shingled roof is seen at an angle from a railed deck in the foreground. Trees, a small flag on a golf green, and layered mountain ridges fill the distance. Inscribed "Fairfield Mts N.C. May 81 G Link", with a faint pencil note "Lake Lure" at lower left.

column2: Black ink drawing of tall palmetto palms beside a porch overlooking a lagoon, Hilton Head.
column3: A black pen drawing on a cream page. A tall palm with a rough trunk rises through the center, with a second palm behind the corner of a house with a railed porch at left. Beyond is still water with reflections and a far bank of trees and clouds. Grass blades fill the lower right. Inscribed "G Link Hilton Head June '81".

column2: Brown ink drawing of a shingle-roofed vacation house with a bay window and stairs, bicycles parked in front, captioned "Our Villa".
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A house with a steep hatched roof, a chimney, vertical siding, and a projecting bay window stands above a staircase with a railing. A palm tree rises at right and Spanish moss hangs from a branch at upper left. Three bicycles are parked at lower left. Inscribed "G Link Hilton Head June '81" and '"Our Villa"'.

column2: Brown ink drawing of a tree house built in a large branching oak, with a ladder and two children, Hilton Head.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A wooden play house with a gabled roof, platforms, and railings sits high among the heavy limbs of a moss-draped tree. One child climbs a ladder at left and another stands at the base. Inscribed "Tree House Harbor town, Hilton Head June 1981" and signed "G Link".

column2: Blue ink drawing of an egret standing in marsh grass at the water's edge, with birds flying overhead, Hilton Head.
column3: A blue ballpoint drawing with touches of green on a cream page. A long-necked wading bird stands in profile facing left among tall reeds beside water. Outlined trees and shrubs line the far bank, a tall tree stands at upper right, and a line of birds crosses the sky. Inscribed "Egret Hilton Head" and "G Link June 81".

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a red-and-white striped lighthouse above a marina with moored boats, Harbour Town.
column3: A pen and colored pencil drawing on a cream page. A hexagonal lighthouse with red and white bands and a dark lantern room stands at center, reflected in blue water. Boats are tied up at its base and low buildings with a flag and green trees flank it. A chain fence and post cross the foreground. Inscribed "G Link June 81" and "Harbor Town".

column2: Dark ink drawing of a statue of a girl waving a cloth above her head with a dog at her side, on a waterfront, Savannah.
column3: A blue-black pen drawing on a cream page. A bronze-like statue of a girl in a long dress stands on a stepped base with one arm raised high holding a cloth, a collie-type dog beside her. Behind are a river with a sailboat, a far shore, palm trees, a fence, and gulls. Inscribed "Statue in Savannah at Seaport" and "G Link June '81".

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a narrow pink house with a red tile gambrel roof, with an adult and child walking past, Charleston.
column3: A pen and colored pencil drawing on a cream page. A small three-story pink stucco building with a steep red tiled roof, a dormer, a tall brick chimney, and dark shutters fronts a cobbled street. A street lamp stands by the door, and a tall figure and a small child walk at right in front of a blue-green neighboring building. Inscribed "The Pink House Charlestown S.C." and "G Link June '81".

column2: Brown ink drawing of a weathered log tobacco barn with a metal roof in a weedy field, captioned "Old Tobacco Shed N.C."
column3: A brown pen drawing on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. A tall log barn with a rounded, patched metal roof and a small lean-to stands in tall grass and wildflowers, with large trees behind and a split-rail fence in the right foreground. Inscribed "Old Tobacco Shed N.C." and "G Link June '81".

column2: Brown ink drawing of a Greek Revival building with a pedimented portico on four tall square columns, Port Jervis, New York.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A two-story house with a temple-front porch, a fanlight in the pediment, shuttered windows, and a hanging lantern is seen at an angle, with a lower wing at right and shrubs along the walk. Inscribed "Motel Port Jervis N.Y. Sept '81 G Link".

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a yellow shingled house with window boxes of red flowers and an eagle plaque, Chatham, Cape Cod.
column3: A brown pen drawing with colored pencil on a cream page. The gable end of a yellow shingled building has two shuttered windows with boxes of red geraniums, a carved eagle on the wall, a white door, and a small bay window with a blue-grey roof. A tall evergreen and a leafy tree stand at right, and red flowers grow by the step. Inscribed "Cape Cod", "Chatham (Car House)", and "G Link Sept 81".

column2: Brown ink drawing of a harbor with a fishing boat at a dock, a small moored boat, pilings, and a house among trees, Hyannis Port.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. A figure stands on a dock beside a work boat at left; a small cabin boat floats at center; tall weathered pilings bound with rope stand at right. A shingled house sits among billowing trees on the far shore, and masts and gulls appear at the edges. Inscribed "G Link 81 Hyannis Port".

column2: Two sketches on one page: colored pencil rowboats on a beach, and a sideways pencil drawing of buildings with a tower, Hyannis.
column3: A cream page with two drawings. The upper one, in colored pencil, shows four rowboats pulled up on a sandy shore below green dune shrubs, with gulls overhead, captioned "Hyannis". The lower one, in grey pencil and turned ninety degrees, shows a group of shingled buildings with a squat hexagonal tower and trees, captioned "Hyannis" and signed "G Link Sept 81".

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of an ornate iron fountain planted with flowers in a street, captioned "Iron Drinking Fountains for Horses, Nantucket".
column3: A pen and colored pencil drawing on a cream page. A cast-iron fountain with a stepped base, fluted column, and wide basin filled with pink, blue, and yellow flowers stands in the foreground, topped by a lantern on a post with a crossbar sign. Brick and shingled buildings line the street at left. Inscribed "Iron Drinking Fountains for Horses NANTUCKET" and "G Link '81".

column2: Grey pencil drawing of a church steeple rising above a cluster of gabled rooftops, Nantucket.
column3: A grey-blue pencil drawing on a cream page. A square tower with pinnacles and a slender spire topped by a weathervane stands above tightly packed shingled houses with gables, chimneys, shuttered windows, and a roof walk. Trees are outlined behind. Inscribed "North Church Steeple NANTUCKET G Link '81".

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a statue of a robed, crowned figure seen from behind on a stone pedestal, Cascais, Portugal.
column3: A black pen drawing with colored pencil on a cream page. A green-tinted statue of a standing figure in a long cloak and crown, viewed from the back, tops a block pedestal shaded in orange and pink. Ornate buildings with arched windows, balconies, and a clock or medallion stand on either side, and gulls fly overhead. Inscribed "Dom Pedro Statue Cascais Portugal (Harbor) '79" and signed "G Link".

column2: Plain tan back cover of the spiral-bound sketchbook with a small white label reading "S2".
column3: Back cover of the sketchbook, with the spiral binding at right. The board is plain tan-brown with light speckling. A small white paper label at upper left is handwritten "S2".

column2: Brown front cover of a Strathmore spiral sketchbook with the word "Sketch" printed vertically in large green letters.
column3: Front cover of a small spiral-bound sketchbook, bound on the left. The brown textured cover is printed in green with "Sketch" running vertically up the right side and "Strathmore 400 Series, 5 1/2 x 8 1/2, 100 sheets" at lower left. A handwritten Roman numeral "III" is at the top right.

column2: Inside front cover printed with Strathmore paper product information, with "G. Link, Staunton, Va." handwritten at the top.
column3: The brown inside front cover of the sketchbook, with the binding at right. It is printed in pale lettering with text about Strathmore artist papers, boards, and pads and a chart of paper grades. Handwritten in ink at the top is "G. Link Staunton, Va."

column2: Handwritten contents page listing "Gretchen Link" and places visited from 1982 to 1994.
column3: A cream page handwritten in blue and black ink and pencil. It reads: "Gretchen Link; 1982 - Spain, Morocco; 1983 - Netherlands, Germany, Switzerland, France, England; Kentucky; 1984 England, Scotland; West Va.; Charlestown S.C. '94 - Church; Coast Guard Station Nags Head '91".

column2: Ink and blue pencil view from a balcony of a palm-lined beachfront with thatched umbrellas and sunbathers, Torremolinos.
column3: A brown pen drawing with blue colored pencil on a cream page. Seen from above, people sit and lie on sand beneath thatched umbrellas fringed in blue. A row of tall palm trees runs down the center beside a high-rise with balconies, and the blue sea with small boats stretches to the horizon. Inscribed "Torremolinos G Link Oct 82" and "Balcony".

column2: Brown ink drawing of an ornate Moorish-style villa with tiled tower roofs, arched windows, and a round turret, Torremolinos.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A building with a tall square tower under a broad pyramidal tiled roof and spire, a second lower tower, a round corner turret, and arcaded balconies rises above a garden wall. A dark tree stands behind at left and a spiky yucca fills the lower foreground. Inscribed "G Link '82 Torremolinos".

column2: Brown ink drawing of modern high-rise apartment blocks with palm trees and a garden in front and hills behind, Torremolinos.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. Several tall, slab-like buildings with rows of balconies stand against a line of hills, one topped with an aerial. Below are low tiled roofs, shrubs, small palms around an oval pool or lawn, and a large yucca at lower right. Inscribed "Torremolinos Oct 82" and signed "G Link".

column2: Purple ink and colored pencil drawing of a massive old stone tower above yellow cafe umbrellas, captioned "Molina de la Torre".
column3: A purple pen drawing with yellow and green colored pencil on a cream page. A tall, rough, polygonal stone tower with small windows and a plant growing from its top dominates the center. Below it is a row of yellow umbrellas among green shrubs, with a white building and hills at left, a palm at right, and a stone wall in the foreground. Inscribed "Molina de la Torre Torremolinos Oct 82" and signed "G Link".

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a whitewashed Spanish house with a red tile roof, flowered window grilles, and a moped parked outside.
column3: A black pen drawing with colored pencil on a cream page. A two-story house of pale stone blocks has a large orange-red tiled roof with a dormer, four windows with tiled hoods and trailing pink flowers, and a wooden door numbered 33. A moped leans against the wall at right, laundry hangs on a line at upper left, and the sky is blue. Inscribed "Torremolinos Oct 82 Spain" and signed "G Link".

column2: Brown ink drawing of the massive, gnarled trunk of a tree in front of a stone wall, captioned "Magnolia Tree".
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A very thick, fluted and knotted tree trunk divides into two heavy limbs with large leaves, standing before a rough stone wall with grass at its base. Inscribed "Magnolia Tree" at lower left and "G Link Torremolinos Oct 82" at lower right.

column2: Pencil drawing of a small whitewashed cottage with a tile roof and open plank door, captioned "Old Fisherman's Cottage".
column3: A grey pencil drawing on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. A low stuccoed cottage has a sagging tiled roof, a short chimney topped with a cross at left, a rounded chimney at right, and a braced wooden door standing open. A tree leans at the left corner and weeds grow along the wall. Inscribed "Torremolinos", "Old Fisherman's Cottage", and "G Link Oct '82".

column2: Ink and green pencil drawing of a crumbling stone hut with a wooden door, with three cats nearby.
column3: A brown pen drawing with olive-green colored pencil on a cream page. A ruined building with a broken wall at left and a gabled roof has a green plank door set in rough stonework. One cat sits on the roof ridge and two more are on the ground in front, with weeds growing from the walls. Inscribed "Torremolinos Oct 82" and signed "G Link".

column2: Brown ink drawing of a cluster of yucca or dragon trees with spiky leaf crowns on slender trunks.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. Several palm-like plants with rough, curving trunks and star-shaped bursts of narrow leaves grow together from a rocky mound. Signed "G Link" at lower left.

column2: Black ink view through a stone arch and balustrade of a white villa with a tiled tower, captioned "Hotel Porch".
column3: A black pen drawing on a cream page. A large round arch with a wrought-iron lantern frames a view over a stone balustrade to a white building with arched windows, iron grilles, a rooftop gallery, and a tiled pyramidal tower. Palms and shrubs are in the garden between. Inscribed "Hotel Porch" and "G Link Torremolinos Oct '82 Spain".

column2: Brown ink drawing of a wide flight of steps leading up to arched doorways, with potted plants and a hanging lantern.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. Broad steps rise from the foreground to a shaded arcade of round arches on a square pier. A balustrade with planted urns climbs at left among palms and shrubs, a lantern hangs from the wall above, and a tiled eave runs across the top. Inscribed "Hotel Entrance Torremolinos" and "G Link Oct. '82".

column2: Black ink drawing of flat-roofed houses with tiled sheds, laundry lines, and television aerials, with a robed figure, Tangier.
column3: A black pen drawing on a cream page. Boxy stuccoed buildings with ornamental chimney caps and many rooftop aerials rise behind a low tiled structure with shuttered windows. A figure in a long hooded robe stands on the terrace among hanging laundry. Three shuttered windows appear along the bottom. Inscribed vertically "Rooftop in Tangier G Link 82".

column2: Brown ink drawing of a figure in a long hooded robe standing in a tall doorway, Tangier.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A person wrapped in a full-length djellaba with a pointed hood stands facing the viewer in a deep, narrow doorway, arms folded inside the robe. The door frame and wall are hatched, with a few plant sprigs around. Captioned "Tangier" at lower right.

column2: Three brown ink sketches of robed people in Tangier: a veiled woman with a bag, a figure in a doorway, and a face at a window.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page with three small studies. At left a woman in a long robe, headscarf, and face veil walks carrying a handbag. At upper right a figure in a dark hooded robe stands in an arched doorway. At lower right a smiling person in a headscarf looks out from a low shuttered window. Captioned "Tangier".

column2: Brown ink drawing of rooftops in Tangier with a rounded tower, tiled sheds, laundry, and aerials.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A cylindrical stuccoed structure rises between boxy buildings with chimneys and television aerials, above a low tiled-roof house with shuttered doors and washing on a line. Three shuttered windows are sketched along the bottom edge. Inscribed "Tangier '82" and signed "G Link".

column2: Blue ink drawing of a crowd of fishing boats with tall masts moored together, inside a ruled border, Spain.
column3: A blue ballpoint drawing on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. Several wooden fishing boats with cabins, masts, and angled booms are rafted together on rippling water, with two small rowboats in front. The scene is enclosed in a hand-ruled rectangle. Inscribed "G Link 82 Spain" at lower left.

column2: Ink and colored pencil drawing of garden steps leading to two arches under a purple sky, with palms, captioned "Hotel Steps".
column3: A brown pen drawing with bright colored pencil on a cream page. Wide steps shaded in purple climb through green shrubs to a wall with two round arches showing blue sky. The sky above is colored purple-pink, a tall palm stands at right, and lawn fills the foreground. Inscribed "Torremolinos 82" and "G Link Hotel Steps".

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a window enclosed by a projecting iron grille with a tiled hood and potted flowers.
column3: A black pen drawing with colored pencil on a cream page. A tall window with shutters is caged by vertical iron bars beneath a small canopy of pink-red roof tiles. Behind the bars, pots of pink flowers and trailing green vines sit on a blue tiled sill supported by scrolled brackets. Inscribed "Torrimelonis Spain Oct '82" and signed "G Link".

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a white house with purple-tiled roofs and hanging flowerpots, captioned "House at the top of the Steps".
column3: A brown pen drawing with purple, blue, and yellow colored pencil on a cream page. A two-story whitewashed house has a tiled main roof and a tiled porch roof on posts, both shaded purple, with rows of flowerpots hung along the balcony and windows with grilles and window boxes. A blue-shaded terrace and stone steps lie in front. Inscribed "Torremolinos 82" and "G Link House at the top of the Steps".

column2: Colored pencil drawing of a tall stone bridge spanning a deep gorge between green cliffs, captioned "New Bridge, Ronda".
column3: A brown pen drawing with green, grey, and blue colored pencil on a cream page. A massive masonry bridge with a tall central arch and two smaller upper arches joins the sheer sides of a ravine. The cliffs are shaded bright green, buildings line the top at right, and the sky is pale blue. Inscribed "New Bridge RONDA".

column2: Pencil and pink colored pencil drawing looking through a large stone arch at a church tower and rooftops, Ronda.
column3: A grey pencil drawing with magenta colored pencil on a cream page. A heavy gateway with a pitched roof, finials, and a round arch, shaded pink, frames a view of a square tower with a clock, tiled roofs, and a small gabled gatehouse. Inscribed in pencil "Moro Chair & Arabe Arch Ronda" and signed "G Link 82".

column2: Black ink drawing of a window covered by an ornate bulging wrought-iron grille with scrollwork, Ronda, Spain.
column3: A black pen drawing on a cream page. A tall shuttered window is enclosed by a projecting iron cage whose bars swell outward at the middle, decorated with small scrolls and topped with a curled cresting, above a stone sill. Inscribed "Window Grill Ronda Spain" and signed "G Link 82".

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a tall church bell tower with arched openings and a clock, beside a palm tree, Ronda.
column3: A black pen drawing with colored pencil on a cream page. A multi-stage stone tower with paired belfry arches, a round clock face, and an octagonal lantern with pinnacles rises against a blue sky. A lower arcaded building adjoins at right and a green palm stands at left. Inscribed "G Link 82" and "Ronda SPAIN".

column2: Ink and colored pencil drawing of a church clock tower with a steep spire above gabled houses, Amsterdam.
column3: A brown pen drawing with blue and green colored pencil on a cream page. A tall square tower with clock faces and a pointed spire rises behind a row of steep-roofed houses with dormers, chimneys, and ball finials. Green lawn and hedges fill the foreground under a blue sky. Inscribed "G Link" and "View from our window Amsterdam June 1983".

column2: Blue ink drawing of a twin-gabled inn with awnings and an outdoor terrace of tables and chairs, Grefrath, Germany.
column3: A blue ballpoint drawing on a cream page. A building with two timbered gables carries signs reading "Weinstube" and "Restaurant" over striped awnings. In front are round cafe tables and chairs, a street lamp, potted flowers, and steps with a railing descending at left. Inscribed "Grefrather Hotel Grefrath, Germany June 83" and signed "G Link".

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a stone cottage with a slate roof, dormer, arched doors, and red flowers, Germany.
column3: A black pen drawing with purple, yellow, and red colored pencil on a cream page. A low stone building with a large blue-violet slate roof and a wide dormer has two arched plank doors with steps, small arched windows, and urns and beds of red flowers along the front. Trees and chimneys show above the ridge. Inscribed "G Link June 83" and "Caretakers Cottage Lodge Germany".

column2: Ink and colored pencil drawing of a yellow building's entrance with a paneled door, balcony of red flowers, and shuttered window.
column3: A brown pen drawing with colored pencil on a cream page. A yellow-walled facade has a tall brown door with a carved ornament above it, flanked by urns of red flowers. Over the door is a stone balcony lined with red geraniums in front of a shuttered window, beneath a blue slate roof with chimneys. Inscribed "G Link 83" and 'Hotel Entrance "Hunting Lodge" Germany'.

column2: Brown ink drawing of an octagonal roof turret with a bell-shaped dome and weathervane above three dormers, Germany.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A two-stage octagonal tower with windows on each face and a curved, ribbed dome topped by a weathervane rises from a roof ridge. Three small gabled dormer windows are lined up across the roof slope below. Inscribed "G Link 83", "Hotel Jagdschloss Niederwald", and '"Hunting Lodge" Germany'.

column2: Black ink drawing of a village of steep-roofed houses beside a pond, below a forested hillside, Black Forest, Germany.
column3: A black pen drawing on a cream page. Houses with tall pitched roofs and chimneys are scattered among fir trees, with a pond reflecting them at lower left and smoke rising from a chimney at right. A farmhouse sits higher on a slope beneath a dense band of conifers. Inscribed "G Link 83" and "Black Forest Germany".

column2: Brown ink drawing of a hotel room with an armchair and a lamp on a pedestal table before a tall curtained window, Lucerne.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A high-backed upholstered armchair stands at left beside a round table on a turned pedestal with tripod feet, carrying a lamp with a pleated, fringed shade. Behind are tall French windows framed by long patterned drapes. Inscribed "G Link 83" and "Hotel Room Lucern Swiss".

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a curving staircase with a carved wooden banister and red carpet runner, Lucerne.
column3: A black pen drawing with red, green, and grey colored pencil on a cream page. Carpeted stairs in red rise to the upper right beside a sweeping balustrade with turned balusters and a heavy newel post. An ornate ironwork balcony with a planter and a red flower hangs above at left, and a patterned vase with a plant sits at the top of the stairs. Inscribed "G Link June 83" and "Staircase in Hotel Lucern Switzerland".

column2: Ink and colored pencil drawing of rooftops and church towers with red domes, Dijon, France.
column3: A brown pen drawing with yellow and red-brown colored pencil on a cream page. A cluster of buildings in the upper half includes a church with twin domed towers and a square tower with a pyramid roof, tinted yellow, above houses with red roofs, dormers, and chimneys stepping down to the right. Inscribed "Dijon France June '83".

column2: Ink and colored pencil view from above of a Paris corner cafe with awnings, sidewalk tables, and two cars.
column3: A brown pen drawing with grey and green colored pencil on a cream page. A tall building with balconies stands over a cafe whose stacked awnings read "Tuborg" and "Tabac des Ternes". Small figures sit at round tables on the pavement between two green trees, and two cars pass on the street below. Inscribed "G Link 83" and "outdoor cafe from window of Hotel Concorde La Faette Paris".

column2: Brown ink drawing of Paris buildings with steep roofs, dormers, a roof terrace, and shop awnings on a street below.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A gabled building with dormers and shuttered windows stands above street-level shops with awnings, where small figures and a car pass a curved street lamp. Behind rise stacked rooftops, a planted roof terrace, chimneys, and television aerials. Inscribed "G Link 83" and "Paris Hotel window".

column2: Ink drawing with touches of blue and pink of a jumble of Paris rooftops, chimney pots, and an aerial.
column3: A brown pen drawing with light blue and pink colored pencil on a cream page. Seen from above, zinc roofs, tall chimney stacks with rows of pots, and a tower block crowd together, with a large aerial at center and a faint skyline with a domed church in the distance. Inscribed "G Link" and "Hotel window Paris 83".

column2: Black ink drawing of a large half-timbered hotel with three gables and a red sign, Canterbury, England.
column3: A black pen drawing on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. A four-story building with three black-and-white timbered gables, bay windows, and arched ground-floor windows stands on a street corner. A small sign on the facade is colored red. Inscribed "G Link 83", "County Hotel Canterbury Eng", and "(Great food)".

column2: Brown ink drawing of a gabled riverside house beside a stone bridge and twin round towers, Canterbury.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. A tall weatherboarded house with a tiled roof and chimney stands at left above shrubs, with a figure at its door. A low arched bridge crosses a river at center, where small figures stand, and two ivy-covered round stone towers rise behind at right. Inscribed "G Link" and "Canterbury June 83".

column2: Ink and colored pencil drawing of a half-timbered gabled house with a two-story bay window and tall chimney, Canterbury.
column3: A brown pen drawing with pink, blue, and yellow colored pencil on a cream page. A timber-framed gable with curved braces sits over a leaded bay window that continues to the ground floor, beside a small door. A tall brick chimney rises from the pink tiled roof, and yellow daffodils bloom at lower right. Inscribed "G Link 83" and "Cantabury Eng".

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of an old inn with a steep tiled roof, hanging flower baskets, and signs reading "Established 1403" and "Falstaff Hotel".
column3: A black pen drawing with colored pencil on a cream page. A jettied, three-story building has a steep pink-tiled roof, the words "Established 1403" across its upper wall, a hanging pictorial sign of a figure in red on a scrolled iron bracket, baskets of red and blue flowers, and bay windows flanking the door. Inscribed "G Link 1983" and "Falstof Hotel Cantabury Eng".

column2: Brown ink drawing of a crenellated stone church tower behind tiled roofs and tall chimneys, Canterbury.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A square battlemented tower with narrow openings rises behind a steep tiled roof. In front are a gable with stone coping and three tall chimney stacks with pots, seen from an upper window. Inscribed "G Link 82" and "Hotel window County Hotel Cantabury".

column2: Brown ink drawing of a bird perched on a stone chimney with a domed cap, with other birds flying around.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A rough stone chimney with a rounded cap and a single pot stands on a roof ridge above two arched dormer windows. One bird perches on the pot, another on the ridge at right, and several fly in the sky. Inscribed "G Link 82" and "Window at County Hotel Cantabury".

column2: Black ink drawing of rooftops with a brick chimney stack, trees, and flat modern building forms, London.
column3: A black pen drawing on a cream page. A gabled roof with a small dormer sits in the foreground. Behind it are billowing trees and a tall brick chimney stack with several pots and a small sign on a pole, and at left the stacked rectangular slabs of a modern building. Inscribed "G Link 83" and "London 83".

column2: Pen drawing of a police officer in profile wearing a kepi and a dark uniform with a red shoulder cord, captioned "Parisian gendarme".
column3: A black pen drawing with red pen on a cream page. A man is shown from the chest up, facing left, wearing a flat-topped cap with a visor that shades his eyes and a uniform outlined in red at the shoulder with a braided red cord. Inscribed "Parisian gendarme '83" and signed "G Link".

column2: Brown ink drawing of a crowd in a Paris square with the domes of a white church rising beyond the buildings.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. People stand and stroll in an open street, including an adult with a small child in the foreground. Buildings with balconies and awnings line the left side, a tree overhangs at upper right, and a tall elongated dome and a smaller dome rise in the background. Inscribed "Paris 83" and signed "G Link".

column2: Pen and colored pencil drawing of a triple-arched triumphal arch topped with a chariot sculpture, behind a curving bed of red flowers.
column3: A black pen drawing with red, green, and tan colored pencil on a cream page. A monumental arch with three openings and columns, crowned by a sculpture of horses and a chariot, stands among green trees. Two cars and small figures pass in front, and a wide, curving bed of red flowers edged in green sweeps through the foreground. Inscribed "G Link" and "Arc de triomphe Paris 83".

column2: Faint pencil outline sketch of the Eiffel Tower.
column3: A light, unfinished pencil sketch on a cream page showing the Eiffel Tower in simple outline, with its tapering upper section, two platforms, and broad arched base, and a few marks indicating trees and figures at ground level.

column2: Black ink drawing of a small log cabin with steps beneath tall trees, behind a split-rail fence, Bardstown, Kentucky.
column3: A black pen drawing on a cream page. A one-room log cabin with a shingled roof and a railed stair to its door stands on a slope among slender trees, with a rail fence across the foreground. Inscribed "Bartstown Ky.", "Cabin in front of Stephen Foster Playhouse", and "Oct 83 G Link".

column2: Black ink drawing of a two-story brick mansion with shuttered windows and tall chimneys, framed by trees, Bardstown, Kentucky.
column3: A black pen drawing on a cream page. A symmetrical Federal-style house with a central doorway, fanlight, and rows of shuttered windows stands behind two tall trees, with round shrubs along the front and a curving drive in the foreground. Inscribed "G Link", "Stephen Foster Playhouse", and "Bartstown Ky".

column2: Brown ink drawing of a motel building with a pedimented two-story porch on tall square columns, Bardstown, Kentucky.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a cream page. A portico with four tall posts and a triangular gable fronts a two-story building with rows of windows and a balcony. Round shrubs line the front and a car is parked at right. Inscribed "Bartstown Ky Parkway Motel Oct 83" and signed "G Link".

column2: Brown ink sketch of travelers seated in an airport concourse beneath a sweeping curved roof and tall slanted piers, Dulles Airport.
column3: A brown pen drawing on a page turned sideways, with the binding at the top. A swooping roofline and large window wall rise to three massive, leaning columns at right. Below, rows of seats are filled with small figures and luggage, with a few people standing or walking. Inscribed "Dulles Airport G Link Sept 84".

column2: Faint pencil sketch of large angled architectural beams and a curved ceiling.
column3: A light pencil drawing on a cream page showing heavy diagonal beams or braces meeting a tall pier beneath a curved band with a row of oval lights, with vertical lines suggesting windows or columns. The subject appears to be the interior structure of a modern building, left unfinished.
